lemma `tlsf_coalesced_mono`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_coalesced(xs, hd)
  2. ∀ m : W32, MEM(m, xs) && tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_used(nh(m))
then
  tlsf_coalesced(xs, nh)
```

lemma `tlsf_hd_splice`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r : W32),
  HD(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs)))) == HD(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)))
```

lemma `tlsf_coalesced_splice`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. zs == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(HD(zs)))
then
  tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
```

lemma `tlsf_layout_interior`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top m r : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
  3. val(m) < val(r)
  4. val(r) < val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
then
  !MEM(r, xs)
```

lemma `tlsf_bins_match_transport`

```
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. ∀ m : W32,
       (MEM(m, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(m))) == (MEM(m, ys) && !tlsf_used(nh(m)))
  2. ∀ m : W32,
       MEM(m, xs)
       && !tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_level_of(nh(m))
       && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_slot_of(nh(m))
then
  tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl) == tlsf_bins_match(ys, nh, bl)
```

lemma `tlsf_bin_add_mem`

```
∀ (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (f j i k : Num) (r m : W32),
  MEM(m, tlsf_bin_add(bl, f, j, r, i, k))
    == (MEM(m, bl(i, k)) || i == f && k == j && m == r)
```

lemma `tlsf_bin_add_count_other`

```
∀ (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (f j i k : Num) (r m : W32)
if
  1. !(m == r)
then
  tlsf_count(m, tlsf_bin_add(bl, f, j, r, i, k)) == tlsf_count(m, bl(i, k))
```

lemma `tlsf_bins_match_insert`

```
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (r : W32) (f j : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. !MEM(r, xs)
  3. f < 28
  4. j < 16
  5. MEM(r, ys)
  6. !tlsf_used(nh(r))
  7. tlsf_level_of(nh(r)) == f
  8. tlsf_slot_of(nh(r)) == j
  9. ∀ m : W32,
       !(m == r) → (MEM(m, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(m)))
         == (MEM(m, ys) && !tlsf_used(nh(m)))
       && (
            MEM(m, xs)
            && !tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_level_of(nh(m))
            && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_slot_of(nh(m)))
then
  tlsf_bins_match(ys, nh, tlsf_bin_add(bl, f, j, r))
```

lemma `tlsf_mem_hd`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32])
if
  1. !(xs == NIL)
then
  MEM(HD(xs), xs)
```

lemma `tlsf_coalesced_suffix`

```
∀ (ys xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, xs), hd)
then
  tlsf_coalesced(xs, hd)
```

lemma `tlsf_layout_cut_at`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
then
  tlsf_path(ys, a, lim, hd, val(m))
  && tlsf_layout(tlsf_end(p, ys), val(m), lim, top, CONS(m, zs), hd)
```

lemma `tlsf_layout_glue`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m p top : W32) (a b lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_path(ys, a, lim, hd, b)
  2. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == nh(x)
  3. tlsf_layout(tlsf_end(p, ys), b, lim, top, CONS(m, zs), nh)
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), nh)
```

lemma `tlsf_physical_split`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_used(nh(m))
  4. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == nh(x)
  5. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == nh(x)
  6. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(nh(m)))
  7. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(m))), 8) == 0
  8. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(nh(r)))
  9. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(r))), 8) == 0
  10. val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(nh(m)))
  11. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(nh(r))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  12. !tlsf_last(nh(m))
  13. tlsf_last(nh(r)) == tlsf_last(hd(m))
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { r } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))),
    nh)
```

lemma `tlsf_size_low_bits`

```
∀ (h : W32),
  (tlsf_size(h) &₃₂ 1w) == 0w
  && (tlsf_size(h) &₃₂ 2w) == 0w
  && (tlsf_size(h) &₃₂ 4294967294w) == tlsf_size(h)
  && (tlsf_size(h) &₃₂ 4294967293w) == tlsf_size(h)
```

lemma `tlsf_clean_low_bits`

```
∀ (n : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_size(n) == n
then
  (n &₃₂ 1w) == 0w
  && (n &₃₂ 2w) == 0w
  && (n &₃₂ 4294967294w) == n
  && (n &₃₂ 4294967293w) == n
```

lemma `tlsf_last_mask_bit`

```
∀ (h : W32), (h &₃₂ 2w) == (if bit(1, h) { 2w } else { 0w })
```

lemma `tlsf_last_mask_cases`

```
∀ (h : W32), (h &₃₂ 2w) == 0w || (h &₃₂ 2w) == 2w
```

lemma `tlsf_used_store_fields`

```
∀ (h : W32),
  tlsf_size((h &₃₂ 4294967294w |₃₂ 1w)) == tlsf_size(h)
  && tlsf_last((h &₃₂ 4294967294w |₃₂ 1w)) == tlsf_last(h)
  && tlsf_used((h &₃₂ 4294967294w |₃₂ 1w))
```

lemma `tlsf_taken_fields`

```
∀ (n : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_size(n) == n
then
  tlsf_size((n |₃₂ 1w)) == n
  && !tlsf_last((n |₃₂ 1w))
  && tlsf_used((n |₃₂ 1w))
```

lemma `tlsf_remainder_fields`

```
∀ (s h : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_size(s) == s
then
  tlsf_size((s |₃₂ h &₃₂ 2w)) == s
  && tlsf_last((s |₃₂ h &₃₂ 2w)) == tlsf_last(h)
  && !tlsf_used((s |₃₂ h &₃₂ 2w))
```

lemma `tlsf_remainder_seed_size`

```
∀ (s old : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_size(s) == s
then
  tlsf_size(((s |₃₂ old &₃₂ 3w) &₃₂ 4294967294w)) == s
```

lemma `tlsf_remainder_seed_clear`

```
∀ (s old : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_size(s) == s
then
  ((s |₃₂ old &₃₂ 3w) &₃₂ 4294967294w &₃₂ 4294967293w) == s
```

lemma `tlsf_split_taken_last`

```
∀ (n h : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_size(n) == n
then
  ((n |₃₂ h &₃₂ 4294967293w &₃₂ 3w) &₃₂ 4294967294w |₃₂ 1w) == (n |₃₂ 1w)
```

lemma `tlsf_split_taken_next`

```
∀ (n h : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_size(n) == n
  2. (h &₃₂ 2w) == 0w
then
  ((n |₃₂ h &₃₂ 3w) &₃₂ 4294967294w |₃₂ 1w) == (n |₃₂ 1w)
```

lemma `tlsf_mod16_8`

```
∀ (x : Num)
if
  1. MOD(x, 16) == 0
then
  MOD(x, 8) == 0
```

lemma `tlsf_mod8_4`

```
∀ (x : Num)
if
  1. MOD(x, 8) == 0
then
  MOD(x, 4) == 0
```

lemma `tlsf_val_add_exact`

```
∀ (x y : W32)
if
  1. val(x) + val(y) < 4294967296
then
  val((x +₃₂ y)) == val(x) + val(y)
```

lemma `tlsf_split_test`

```
∀ (h n : W32)
if
  1. val(n) <= 4160749568
then
  word_ugt(tlsf_size(h), (n +₃₂ 264w)) == (val(n) + 264 < val(tlsf_size(h)))
```

lemma `tlsf_aligned_sub`

```
∀ (z n : Num)
if
  1. MOD(z, 8) == 0
  2. MOD(n, 8) == 0
  3. n + 8 <= z
then
  MOD(z - n - 8, 8) == 0
```

lemma `tlsf_remainder_value`

```
∀ (h n : W32)
if
  1. val(n) + 8 <= val(tlsf_size(h))
then
  val(tlsf_remainder_size(h, n)) == val(tlsf_size(h)) - val(n) - 8
```

lemma `tlsf_split_bounds`

```
∀ (m n : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (lim : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)
  2. lim <= 4294967296
  3. 16 <= val(n)
  4. val(n) <= 4160749568
  5. MOD(val(n), 16) == 0
  6. val(n) + 264 < val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
then
  val(tlsf_remainder(m, n)) == val(m) + 8 + val(n)
  && !(tlsf_remainder(m, n) == 0w)
  && !(tlsf_remainder(m, n) == m)
  && MOD(val(tlsf_remainder(m, n)), 8) == 0
  && val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) - val(n) - 8
  && 16 <= val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n))
  && MOD(val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)), 8) == 0
  && tlsf_size(n) == n
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)
  && val(n) + 8 + val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
```

lemma `tlsf_byte_div`

```
∀ (h : Byte) (n : Num), DIV(val(h) + 256 * n, 256) == n
```

lemma `tlsf_le_bytes_num`

```
∀ (bs : List[Byte]), le_bytes(LENGTH(bs), num_of_bytes(bs)) == bs
```

lemma `tlsf_le_bytes_length`

```
∀ (k n : Num), LENGTH(le_bytes(k, n)) == k
```

lemma `tlsf_le_bytes_mod`

```
∀ (k n : Num), le_bytes(k, MOD(n, EXP(256, k))) == le_bytes(k, n)
```

lemma `tlsf_serialise_deserialise`

```
∀ (bs : List[Byte])
if
  1. LENGTH(bs) == 4
then
  serialise_i32(deserialise_i32(bs)) == bs
```

lemma `tlsf_bytes_word`

```
∀ (a : Num),
  tlsf_bytes(a, 4) == ((h : Heap) => ∃ v : W32, pts(a, serialise_i32(v), h))
```

lemma `tlsf_take_drop`

```
∀ (xs : List[Byte]) (n : Num), APPEND(take(n, xs), drop(n, xs)) == xs
```

lemma `tlsf_bytes_split`

```
∀ (a n k : Num),
  tlsf_bytes(a, n + k) == (tlsf_bytes(a, n) * tlsf_bytes(a + n, k))
```

lemma `tlsf_bytes_four_words`

```
∀ (a : Num),
  tlsf_bytes(a, 16) == (
    (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ w0 : W32,
        ∃ w1 : W32,
          ∃ pf : W32,
            ∃ nf : W32,
              (
                (
                  pts(a, serialise_i32(w0))
                  * pts(a + 4, serialise_i32(w1))
                  * pts(a + 8, serialise_i32(pf))
                  * pts(a + 12, serialise_i32(nf)))(h)))
```

lemma `tlsf_split_payload_cut`

```
∀ (a n s z : Num)
if
  1. 16 <= s
  2. n + 8 + s == z
then
  tlsf_bytes(a, z) == (
    tlsf_bytes(a, n) * tlsf_bytes(a + n, 16) * tlsf_bytes(a + n + 16, s - 8))
```

```
∀ (d : W32), call_free_b(tlsf_push_code(d))
```

lemma `tlsf_split_in_module`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32) (push : Num)
  (P Q : SAssn)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. sl_triple_g(
       tlsf_proved_spec(
         sfunc_ind(inst, push),
         tlsf_push_code(d),
         [V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
         1,
         1),
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         false,
       P,
       tlsf_split_code(d, push),
       Q,
       NIL)
then
  sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, P, tlsf_split_code(d, push), Q, NIL)
```

lemma `sl_ex_m`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)
  (P : (A, List[Value], List[Value], List[Value], Num, Heap) -> Bool)
  (code : List[B_e]) (Q : SAssn) (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ x : A, sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, P(x), code, Q, labels)
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ x : A, P(x, vs, lc, gs, ms, h),
    code,
    Q,
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_physical_mark`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == nh(x)
  3. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == nh(x)
  4. tlsf_size(nh(m)) == tlsf_size(hd(m))
  5. tlsf_last(nh(m)) == tlsf_last(hd(m))
  6. tlsf_used(nh(m))
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), nh)
```

lemma `tlsf_focus_distinct`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
then
  !MEM(m, ys)
  && !MEM(m, zs)
```

lemma `tlsf_mark_focus`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m))
  && tlsf_regions(0w, ys, tlsf_mark(hd, m)) == tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
  && tlsf_regions(m, zs, tlsf_mark(hd, m)) == tlsf_regions(m, zs, hd)
  && tlsf_mark(hd, m, m) == (hd(m) &₃₂ 4294967294w |₃₂ 1w)
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_mark(hd, m, m)) == tlsf_size(hd(m))
  && tlsf_used(tlsf_mark(hd, m, m))
```

lemma `tlsf_split_focus_geometry`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m n d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. 16 <= val(n)
  4. val(n) <= 4160749568
  5. MOD(val(n), 16) == 0
  6. val(n) + 264 < val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
then
  val(tlsf_remainder(m, n)) == val(m) + 8 + val(n)
  && !(tlsf_remainder(m, n) == 0w)
  && !(tlsf_remainder(m, n) == m)
  && val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) - val(n) - 8
  && 16 <= val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n))
  && MOD(val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)), 8) == 0
  && tlsf_size(n) == n
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)
  && val(n) + 8 + val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  && !MEM(tlsf_remainder(m, n), APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)))
  && !MEM(m, ys)
  && !MEM(m, zs)
```

lemma `tlsf_split_focus`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m n d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. 16 <= val(n)
  4. val(n) <= 4160749568
  5. MOD(val(n), 16) == 0
  6. val(n) + 264 < val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { tlsf_remainder(m, n) } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(tlsf_remainder(m, n), zs))),
    tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n))
  && ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n, x)
  && ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n, x)
  && tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n, m) == (n |₃₂ 1w)
  && tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n, tlsf_remainder(m, n))
       == (tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n) |₃₂ hd(m) &₃₂ 2w)
```

lemma `tlsf_push_bl_add`

```
∀ (h r : W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  tlsf_push_bl(h, r, bl)
    == tlsf_bin_add(bl, tlsf_level_of(h), tlsf_slot_of(h), r)
```

lemma `tlsf_push_size_cong`

```
∀ (h v r fl : W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_size(h) == tlsf_size(v)
then
  tlsf_push_fl(h, fl) == tlsf_push_fl(v, fl)
  && tlsf_push_sb(h, sb) == tlsf_push_sb(v, sb)
  && tlsf_push_bl(h, r, bl) == tlsf_push_bl(v, r, bl)
```

lemma `tlsf_split_bins_focus`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m n : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  2. !MEM(tlsf_remainder(m, n), APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)))
  3. !(tlsf_remainder(m, n) == m)
  4. tlsf_size(n) == n
  5. tlsf_size(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)
  6. 16 <= val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n))
then
  tlsf_bins_match(
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(tlsf_remainder(m, n), zs))),
    tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n),
    tlsf_push_bl(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), tlsf_remainder(m, n), bl))
```

lemma `tlsf_mark_close`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m d top fl : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : HProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
then
  (
    pts(val((tlsf_base(d) +₃₂ 1908w)), serialise_i32(top))
    * tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
    * pts(val(m), serialise_i32((hd(m) &₃₂ 4294967294w |₃₂ 1w)))
    * pts(val((m +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
    * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
    * tlsf_regions(m, zs, hd)
    * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
    * fp) == (
    tlsf_large(
      d,
      lim,
      top,
      APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
      tlsf_mark(hd, m),
      fl,
      sb,
      bl)
    * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
    * fp)
```

lemma `tlsf_split_close`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m n d top fl : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : HProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(
       d,
       lim,
       if zs == NIL { tlsf_remainder(m, n) } else { top },
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(tlsf_remainder(m, n), zs))),
       tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n))
  2. tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(tlsf_remainder(m, n), zs))),
       tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n),
       tlsf_push_bl(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), tlsf_remainder(m, n), bl))
  3. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n, x)
  4. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n, x)
  5. tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n, m) == (n |₃₂ 1w)
  6. tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n, tlsf_remainder(m, n))
       == (tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n) |₃₂ hd(m) &₃₂ 2w)
  7. tlsf_size(n) == n
  8. tlsf_size(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)
then
  (
    pts(
      val((tlsf_base(d) +₃₂ 1908w)),
      serialise_i32(if zs == NIL { tlsf_remainder(m, n) } else { top }))
    * tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
    * pts(val(m), serialise_i32((n |₃₂ 1w)))
    * pts(val((m +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
    * pts(
        val(tlsf_remainder(m, n)),
        serialise_i32((tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n) |₃₂ hd(m) &₃₂ 2w)))
    * pts(val((tlsf_remainder(m, n) +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(m))
    * tlsf_bytes(
        val(tlsf_remainder(m, n)) + 16,
        val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) - 8)
    * tlsf_regions(tlsf_remainder(m, n), zs, hd)
    * tlsf_bins(
        d,
        tlsf_push_fl(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), fl),
        tlsf_push_sb(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), sb),
        tlsf_push_bl(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), tlsf_remainder(m, n), bl))
    * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(n))
    * fp) == (
    tlsf_large(
      d,
      lim,
      if zs == NIL { tlsf_remainder(m, n) } else { top },
      APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(tlsf_remainder(m, n), zs))),
      tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n),
      tlsf_push_fl(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), fl),
      tlsf_push_sb(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), sb),
      tlsf_push_bl(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), tlsf_remainder(m, n), bl))
    * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(n))
    * fp)
```

lemma `tlsf_split_whole`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n top fl : W32)
  (push lim : Num) (ys zs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 l4 l5 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  5. 16 <= val(n)
  6. val(n) <= 4160749568
  7. MOD(val(n), 16) == 0
  8. val(n) <= val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  9. !word_ugt(tlsf_size(hd(m)), (n +₃₂ 264w))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd(m)))
          * (
              (h : Heap) =>
                ms == lim
                && (
                     (
                       pts(
                         val((tlsf_base(d) +₃₂ 1908w)),
                         serialise_i32(top))
                       * tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
                       * pts(
                           val((m +₃₂ 4w)),
                           serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
                       * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
                       * tlsf_regions(m, zs, hd)
                       * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
                       * fp(gs, ms))(h))))),
    tlsf_split_code(d, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      LENGTH(lc) == 6
      && EL(0, lc) == V_num(ConstInt32(m))
      && EL(3, lc) == V_num(ConstInt32(n))
      && vs == NIL
      && ms == lim
      && (
           (
             tlsf_large(
               d,
               lim,
               top,
               APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
               tlsf_mark(hd, m),
               fl,
               sb,
               bl)
             * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
             * fp(gs, ms))(h)),
    NIL)
```

               tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n),
               tlsf_push_fl(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), fl),

  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (xs2 : List[W32]),
  (hd2 : (W32) -> W32)) == (
  ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, xs) && tlsf_used(hd(x)) → MEM(x, xs2) && hd2(x) == hd(x))
```

lemma `tlsf_retains_mark`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (m : W32)
if
  1. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
then
  tlsf_retains(xs, hd, xs, tlsf_mark(hd, m))
```

lemma `tlsf_retains_split`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (m n : W32)
if
  1. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  2. !MEM(tlsf_remainder(m, n), APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)))
then
  tlsf_retains(
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    hd,
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(tlsf_remainder(m, n), zs))),
    tlsf_split_headers(hd, m, n))
```

definition `tlsf_detached`

```
tlsf_detached(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (ys : List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (zs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
    && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
    && tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
    && (
         (
           pts(
             val((tlsf_base((d : W32)) +₃₂ 1908w)),
             serialise_i32((top : W32)))
           * tlsf_regions(0w, (ys : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
           * pts(val((m : W32)), serialise_i32((hd : (W32) -> W32)(m)))
           * pts(
               val(((m : W32) +₃₂ 4w)),
               serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, (ys : List[W32]))))
           * tlsf_bytes(
               val((m : W32)) + 8,
               val(tlsf_size((hd : (W32) -> W32)(m))))
           * tlsf_regions((m : W32), (zs : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
           * tlsf_bins(
               (d : W32),
               (fl : W32),
               (sb : (Num) -> W32),
               (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])))(h)))
```

definition `tlsf_allocated`

```
tlsf_allocated(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (m : W32),
  (n : W32),
  (oldxs : List[W32]),
  (oldhd : (W32) -> W32),
  (client : HProp)) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    !(m == 0w)
    && (
         ∃ top2 : W32,
           ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
             ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl2 : W32,
                 ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     tlsf_retains(oldxs, oldhd, xs2, hd2)
                     && MEM(m, xs2)
                     && tlsf_used(hd2(m))
                     && val(n) <= val(tlsf_size(hd2(m)))
                     && (
                          (
                            tlsf_large(
                              (d : W32),
                              (lim : Num),
                              top2,
                              xs2,
                              hd2,
                              fl2,
                              sb2,
                              bl2)
                            * tlsf_bytes(
                                val((m : W32)) + 8,
                                val(tlsf_size(hd2(m))))
                            * (client : HProp))(h))))
```

definition `tlsf_take_pre`

```
tlsf_take_pre(
  (d : W32),
  (s : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (args : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    args == [V_num(ConstInt32(s))]
    && 16 <= val(s)
    && val(s) <= 4160749568
    && ms == lim
    && h == before
    && (
         (
           tlsf_large(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))
```

definition `tlsf_take_post`

```
tlsf_take_post(
  (d : W32),
  (s : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && (
         res == [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))]
         && tlsf_search(s, fl, sb, bl) == 0w
         && h == before
         && (
              (
                tlsf_large(
                  (d : W32),
                  (lim : Num),
                  (top : W32),
                  (xs : List[W32]),
                  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
                  (fl : W32),
                  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
                  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]))
                * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h))
         || (
              ∃ m : W32,
                res == [V_num(ConstInt32(m))]
                && m == tlsf_search(s, fl, sb, bl)
                && MEM(m, xs)
                && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
                && tlsf_allocated(d, lim, m, s, xs, hd, fp(gs, ms), h))))
```

tlsf_pop_fl((hd : W32), (fl : W32), (sb : (Num) -> W32), (xs : List[W32])) == (

      (sb : (Num) -> W32)(

      ^₃₂ 1w
          <<₃₂ (
                 tlsf_size((hd : W32))
                 >>>₃₂ 27w −₃₂ word(word_clz(tlsf_size((hd : W32)))) &₃₂ 15w)) == 0w {
      ((fl : W32) ^₃₂ 1w <<₃₂ 27w −₃₂ word(word_clz(tlsf_size((hd : W32))))) } else {

    args == [V_num(ConstInt32(m))]

         (

           * tlsf_bins(
               (d : W32),

```
tlsf_pop_post(
  (d : W32),

  (sb : (Num) -> W32),

    && (

           pts(val((m : W32)), serialise_i32((hd : W32)))
           * pts(

               serialise_i32(tlsf_prev((us : List[W32]))))
           * pts(

                 hd,

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n hd fl : W32) (pop : Num)

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n hd fl : W32) (pop : Num)

          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd))

        (
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd))
          * pts(val((m +₃₂ 8w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_prev(us)))
          * pts(val((m +₃₂ 12w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_hd(vs)))
          * tlsf_bins(

```

lemma `tlsf_pop_detach`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n top fl : W32)
  (pop lim : Num) (ys zs us vs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 l4 l5 : Value)
  (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  2. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, bl)
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  5. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    [Local_get(0), Call(pop)],
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_detached(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 ys,
                 m,
                 zs,
                 hd,
                 tlsf_pop_fl(hd(m), fl, sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_sb(hd(m), sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_bl(hd(m), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_split_detached`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n top fl : W32)
  (push lim : Num) (ys zs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 l4 l5 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  5. 16 <= val(n)
  6. val(n) <= 4160749568
  7. MOD(val(n), 16) == 0
  8. val(n) <= val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_detached(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_split_code(d, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      LENGTH(lc) == 6
      && EL(0, lc) == V_num(ConstInt32(m))
      && EL(3, lc) == V_num(ConstInt32(n))
      && vs == NIL
      && ms == lim
      && tlsf_allocated(
           d,
           lim,
           m,
           n,
           APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
           hd,
           fp(gs, ms),
           h),
    NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_take_success_body`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (Q : FProp)
  (d m n top fl : W32) (pop push lim : Num) (ys zs us bs : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (l1 l2 l4 l5 : Value) (fp : GProp) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
     && tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
     && tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, bl)
     && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
     && bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, bs))
  2. 16 <= val(n)
  3. val(n) <= 4160749568
  4. MOD(val(n), 16) == 0
  5. val(n) <= val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  6. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  7. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num,
         ∀ h : Heap,
           (
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
               ms == lim
               && tlsf_allocated(
                    d,
                    lim,
                    m,
                    n,
                    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                    hd,
                    fp(gs, ms),
                    h))(gs, ms, h) → Q([V_num(ConstInt32(m))], gs, ms, h)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      Q(vs, gs, ms, h),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_take_success(d, pop, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      false,
    ls)
```

lemma `tlsf_large_facts_frame`

```
∀ (d top fl : W32) (lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (client : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. (tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl) * client)(h)
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  && tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  && tlsf_tables_sync(fl, sb, bl)
```

lemma `tlsf_search_aligned_sound`

```
∀ (s d top fl : W32) (lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
  3. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  4. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  5. tlsf_tables_sync(fl, sb, bl)
then
  tlsf_find_result(tlsf_align(s), xs, hd, tlsf_search(s, fl, sb, bl))
```

lemma `tlsf_take_bin_member`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (m : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
then
  MEM(m, bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))))
```

lemma `tlsf_take_allocated_post`

```
∀ (d s top fl m n : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (before h : Heap)
  (fp : GProp) (gs : List[Value])
if
  1. ms == lim
  2. tlsf_search(s, fl, sb, bl) == m
  3. MEM(m, xs)
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  5. val(s) <= val(n)
  6. tlsf_allocated(d, lim, m, n, xs, hd, fp(gs, ms), h)
then
  tlsf_take_post(
    d,
    s,
    lim,
    top,
    xs,
    hd,
    fl,
    sb,
    bl,
    before,
    fp,
    [V_num(ConstInt32(m))],
    gs,
    ms,
    h)
```

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d s top fl m : W32)
  (pop push lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (before : Heap) (fp : GProp)
  (l0 l1 l2 l4 l5 : Value)
if

  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  5. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  6. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  7. tlsf_tables_sync(fl, sb, bl)
  8. tlsf_search(s, fl, sb, bl) == m
then

        && h == before
        && ((tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl) * fp(gs, ms))(h))),

      tlsf_take_post(

        lim,
        top,

        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,

    [
      (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>

        tlsf_take_post(
          d,
          s,
          lim,
          top,
          xs,
          hd,
          fl,
          sb,
          bl,
          before,
          fp,
          vs,
          gs,
          ms,

        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && h == before
        && ((tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl) * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_take_post(
        d,
        s,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    [
      (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
      (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        tlsf_take_post(
          d,
          s,
          lim,
          top,
          xs,
          hd,
          fl,
          sb,
          bl,
          before,
          fp,
          vs,
          gs,
          ms,
          h)])
```

lemma `tlsf_take_body`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d s top fl : W32)
  (pop push lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (before : Heap) (fp : GProp)
  (args : List[Value])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_take_post(
        d,
        s,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      vs == NIL
      && lc == APPEND(
           args,
           [V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
            V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
            V_num(ConstInt32(0w))])
      && tlsf_take_pre(
           d,
           s,
           lim,
           top,
           xs,
           hd,
           fl,
           sb,
           bl,
           before,
           fp,
           args,
           gs,
           ms,
           h),
    tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_take_post(
        d,
        s,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    [
      (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
      (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        tlsf_take_post(
          d,
          s,
          lim,
          top,
          xs,
          hd,
          fl,
          sb,
          bl,
          before,
          fp,
          vs,
          gs,
          ms,
          h)])
```

definition `tlsf_take_spec`

```
tlsf_take_spec(
  (inst : Inst),
  (d : W32),
  (pop : Num),
  (push : Num),
  (take_idx : Num),
  (a : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  a == sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx)
  && (
       ∃ s : W32,
         ∃ lim : Num,
           ∃ top : W32,
             ∃ xs : List[W32],
               ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
                 ∃ fl : W32,
                   ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                     ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                       ∃ before : Heap,
                         ∃ fp : GProp,
                           P == tlsf_take_pre(
                             d,
                             s,
                             lim,
                             top,
                             xs,
                             hd,
                             fl,
                             sb,
                             bl,
                             before,
                             fp)
                           && Q == tlsf_take_post(
                                d,
                                s,
                                lim,
                                top,
                                xs,
                                hd,
                                fl,
                                sb,
                                bl,
                                before,
                                fp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_take_spec_call`

```
∀ (inst : Inst) (d s top fl : W32) (pop push take_idx lim : Num)
  (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (before : Heap) (fp : GProp),
  tlsf_take_spec(
    inst,
    d,
    pop,
    push,
    take_idx,
    sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx),
    tlsf_take_pre(d, s, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, before, fp),
    tlsf_take_post(d, s, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, before, fp))
```

lemma `tlsf_take_specs`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32)
  (pop push take_idx k : Num)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  specs_ok(k, tlsf_take_spec(inst, d, pop, push, take_idx), fs, tabs, inst)
```

lemma `tlsf_take_all`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d s top fl : W32)
  (pop push take_idx lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (before : Heap)
  (fp : GProp) (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_take_pre(
             d,
             s,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             before,
             fp,
             args,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    [Call(take_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_take_post(
             d,
             s,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             before,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)
```

definition `tlsf_capacity_at`

```
tlsf_capacity_at((lim : Num), (m : W32))
  == (word((lim : Num)) −₃₂ (m : W32) −₃₂ 8w)
```

definition `tlsf_top_cell`

```
tlsf_top_cell((d : W32)) == (tlsf_base((d : W32)) +₃₂ 1908w)
```

definition `tlsf_ensure_expected`

```
tlsf_ensure_expected((s : W32)) == tlsf_round(tlsf_align(s))
```

definition `tlsf_ensure_pages`

```
tlsf_ensure_pages((s : W32), (h : W32)) == (
  if tlsf_used(h) { (tlsf_ensure_expected((s : W32)) +₃₂ 65543w >>>₃₂ 16w) } else {
    (
      (tlsf_ensure_expected((s : W32)) −₃₂ tlsf_size((h : W32)))
      +₃₂ 65535w >>>₃₂ 16w) })
```

definition `tlsf_extend_headers`

```
tlsf_extend_headers((hd : (W32) -> W32), (m : W32), (lim2 : Num)) == tlsf_put(
  hd,
  m,
  (
    tlsf_capacity_at((lim2 : Num), (m : W32))
    |₃₂ (hd : (W32) -> W32)((m : W32)) &₃₂ 3w))
```

definition `tlsf_append_headers`

```
tlsf_append_headers(
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (m : W32),
  (oldlim : Num),
  (lim2 : Num)) == tlsf_put(
  tlsf_put(hd, m, ((hd : (W32) -> W32)((m : W32)) &₃₂ 4294967293w)),
  word(oldlim),
  (tlsf_capacity_at((lim2 : Num), word((oldlim : Num))) |₃₂ 2w))
```

definition `tlsf_grow_headers`

```
tlsf_grow_headers((hd : (W32) -> W32), (m : W32), (oldlim : Num), (lim2 : Num)) == (
  if tlsf_used(hd(m)) { tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, oldlim, lim2) } else {
    tlsf_extend_headers(hd, m, lim2) })
```

definition `tlsf_grow_top`

```
tlsf_grow_top((hd : (W32) -> W32), (m : W32), (oldlim : Num))
  == (if tlsf_used(hd(m)) { word(oldlim) } else { m })
```

definition `tlsf_grow_chain`

```
tlsf_grow_chain(
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (m : W32),
  (oldlim : Num))
  == (if tlsf_used(hd(m)) { APPEND(xs, [word(oldlim)]) } else { xs })
```

definition `tlsf_ensure_pre`

```
tlsf_ensure_pre(
  (d : W32),

  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),

  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (args : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    args == [V_num(ConstInt32(s))]
    && 16 <= val(s)
    && val(s) <= 4160749568
    && ms == lim
    && h == before
    && (
         (
           tlsf_large(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, (lim : Num)))(h)))

definition `tlsf_ensure_post`

```
tlsf_ensure_post(
  (d : W32),
  (s : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),

  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))]
    && ms == lim
    && h == before
    && (
         (
           tlsf_large(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, (lim : Num)))(h))
    || res == [V_num(ConstInt32(1w))]
       && ms == lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(top))) * 65536
       && lim <= ms
       && ms <= 4294967296
       && !tlsf_used(
            tlsf_grow_headers(hd, top, lim, ms, tlsf_grow_top(hd, top, lim)))
       && val(tlsf_ensure_expected(s)) <= val(
            tlsf_size(
              tlsf_grow_headers(
                hd,
                top,
                lim,
                ms,
                tlsf_grow_top(hd, top, lim))))
       && (
            ∃ fl2 : W32,
              ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                  (
                    (
                      tlsf_large(
                        (d : W32),
                        ms,
                        tlsf_grow_top(
                          (hd : (W32) -> W32),
                          (top : W32),
                          (lim : Num)),
                        tlsf_grow_chain((xs : List[W32]), hd, top, lim),
                        tlsf_grow_headers(hd, top, lim, ms),
                        fl2,
                        sb2,
                        bl2)
                      * (fp : GProp)(gs, (lim : Num)))(h))))

```

    [Memory_grow],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>

          ms == lim && R(gs, lim, h),

         && st(

              lc0,
              (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
                ms == lim + val(c) * 65536

  && tlsf_size(tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, lim, nextlim, word(lim)))

```
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])

if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. !(MEM(r, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(r)))
  3. f < 28
  4. j < 16
  5. MEM(r, ys)
  6. !tlsf_used(nh(r))
  7. tlsf_level_of(nh(r)) == f
  8. tlsf_slot_of(nh(r)) == j
  9. ∀ m : W32,
       !(m == r) → (MEM(m, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(m)))
         == (MEM(m, ys) && !tlsf_used(nh(m)))
       && (
            MEM(m, xs)
            && !tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_level_of(nh(m))
            && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_slot_of(nh(m)))
then

lemma `tlsf_ensure_extend_close`

```
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d m fl : W32) (lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : HProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), nh)
  2. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, [m]), nh, bl)
  3. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  (
    pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(m))
    * tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
    * pts(val(m), serialise_i32(nh(m)))
    * pts(val((m +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
    * tlsf_spare(m, nh(m))
    * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
    * fp)
    == (tlsf_large(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), nh, fl, sb, bl) * fp)
```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_append_close`

```
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d m fl r : W32) (lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : HProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, r, APPEND(ys, [m, r]), nh)
  2. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, [m, r]), nh, bl)
  3. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  (
    pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(r))
    * tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
    * pts(val(m), serialise_i32(nh(m)))
    * pts(val((m +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
    * tlsf_spare(m, nh(m))
    * pts(val(r), serialise_i32(nh(r)))
    * pts(val((r +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(m))
    * tlsf_spare(r, nh(r))
    * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
    * fp)
    == (tlsf_large(d, lim, r, APPEND(ys, [m, r]), nh, fl, sb, bl) * fp)
```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_pop_detach`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n top fl : W32)
  (pop lim extent : Num) (ys zs us vs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  2. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, bl)
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  5. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(n))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == extent
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    [Local_get(0), Call(pop)],
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(n))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == extent
        && (
             (
               tlsf_detached(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 ys,
                 m,
                 zs,
                 hd,
                 tlsf_pop_fl(hd(m), fl, sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_sb(hd(m), sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_bl(hd(m), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    NIL)
```

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m hd fl pf0 nf0 : W32)

lemma `tlsf_ensure_growth_fit`

```
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d s m : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd)
  2. 16 <= val(s)
  3. val(s) <= 4160749568
  4. DIV(lim, 65536) + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) <= 65536
then
  lim <= lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536
  && lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536 <= 4294967296
  && MOD(lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536, 65536) == 0
  && tlsf_physical_ok(
       d,
       lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
       tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim),
       tlsf_grow_chain(APPEND(ys, [m]), hd, m, lim),
       tlsf_grow_headers(
         hd,
         m,
         lim,
         lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536))
  && !tlsf_used(
       tlsf_grow_headers(
         hd,
         m,
         lim,
         lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
         tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim)))
  && val(tlsf_ensure_expected(s)) <= val(
       tlsf_size(
         tlsf_grow_headers(
           hd,
           m,
           lim,
           lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
           tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim))))
```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_grow_control`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp Q : SAssn)
  (d c : W32) (pop push lim : Num) (lc0 : List[Value]) (R : GProp)
  (rest : List[B_e]) (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. lim <= 4294967296
  2. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num,
         ∀ h : Heap,
           (
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
               ms == lim && R(gs, lim, h))(gs, ms, h) → rp(
             [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
             lc0,
             gs,
             ms,
             h)
  3. DIV(lim, 65536) + val(c) <= 65536 → sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       st(
         NIL,
         lc0,
         (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           ms == lim + val(c) * 65536
           && ((R(gs, lim) * pts(lim, REPLICATE(val(c) * 65536, 0w)))(h))),
       rest,
       Q,
       labels)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(c))],
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim && R(gs, ms, h)),
    APPEND([Memory_grow], APPEND(tlsf_ensure_guard(d, pop, push), rest)),
    Q,
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_append_grow`

```
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d m fl : W32) (lim delta : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : HProp) (heap0 : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd)
  2. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. 24 <= delta
  4. lim + delta <= 4294967296
  5. (
       tlsf_large(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd, fl, sb, bl)
       * pts(lim, REPLICATE(delta, 0w))
       * fp)(heap0)
then
  (
    (
      pts((val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(lim)), serialise_i32(0w))
      * pts(val((word(lim) +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(0w))
      * tlsf_bytes(
          (val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(lim)) + 8,
          (val : (W32) -> Num)(
            tlsf_capacity_at(lim + delta, (word : (Num) -> W32)(lim)))))
    * pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(m))
    * tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
    * pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd(m)))
    * pts(val((m +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
    * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
    * fp)(heap0)
```

definition `tlsf_ensure_frame`

```
tlsf_ensure_frame(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (ys : List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
    (
      tlsf_regions(0w, (ys : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
      * pts(
          val(((m : W32) +₃₂ 4w)),
          serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, (ys : List[W32]))))
      * tlsf_spare((m : W32), (hd : (W32) -> W32)(m))
      * tlsf_bins(
          (d : W32),
          (fl : W32),
          (sb : (Num) -> W32),
          (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]))
      * (fp : GProp)(gs, (lim : Num))))
```

definition `tlsf_ensure_saved`

```
tlsf_ensure_saved(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (ys : List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (fp : GProp),
  (before : Heap)) == (
  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && h == before
    && (
         (
           tlsf_large(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (m : W32),
             APPEND((ys : List[W32]), [m]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, (lim : Num)))(h)))
```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_ro_saved`

```
∀ (d m fl : W32) (lim : Num) (ys : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
  (before : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd)
  2. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, [m]), hd, bl)
then
  tlsf_ensure_ro(
    d,
    m,
    hd(m),
    lim,
    before,
    tlsf_ensure_frame(d, lim, ys, m, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp))
    == tlsf_ensure_saved(d, lim, ys, m, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp, before)
```

lemma `tlsf_star_forget_heap_eq`

```
∀ (p q : HProp) (before h : Heap)
if
  1. (((h0 : Heap) => h0 == before && p(h0)) * q)(h)
then
  (p * q)(h)
```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_append`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m e fl : W32)
  (pop push lim lim2 : Num) (ys : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd)
  3. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, [m]), hd, bl)
  5. lim + 24 <= lim2
  6. lim2 <= 4294967296
  7. MOD(lim2, 65536) == 0
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(e))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim2
        && (
             (
               tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
               * pts(val((m +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
               * pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(m))
               * pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd(m)))
               * pts(
                   (val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(lim)),
                   serialise_i32(0w))
               * pts(val((word(lim) +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(0w))
               * tlsf_bytes(
                   (val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(lim)) + 8,
                   (val : (W32) -> Num)(
                     tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, (word : (Num) -> W32)(lim))))
               * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    APPEND(
      tlsf_ensure_used_write(d, pop, push),
      [Local_get(1), Call(push), Drop]),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(lim)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim2
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(
                 d,
                 lim2,
                 word(lim),
                 APPEND(ys, [m, word(lim)]),
                 tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, lim, lim2),
                 tlsf_push_fl(
                   (tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, word(lim)) |₃₂ 2w),
                   fl),
                 tlsf_push_sb(
                   (tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, word(lim)) |₃₂ 2w),
                   sb),
                 tlsf_push_bl(
                   (tlsf_capacity_at(lim2, word(lim)) |₃₂ 2w),
                   word(lim),
                   bl))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    NIL)
```

definition `tlsf_ensure_spec`

```
tlsf_ensure_spec(
  (inst : Inst),
  (d : W32),
  (pop : Num),
  (push : Num),
  (ensure_idx : Num),
  (a : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  a == sfunc_ind(inst, ensure_idx)
  && (
       ∃ s : W32,
         ∃ lim : Num,
           ∃ top : W32,
             ∃ xs : List[W32],
               ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
                 ∃ fl : W32,
                   ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                     ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                       ∃ before : Heap,
                         ∃ fp : GProp,
                           P == tlsf_ensure_pre(
                             d,
                             s,
                             lim,
                             top,
                             xs,
                             hd,
                             fl,
                             sb,
                             bl,
                             before,
                             fp)
                           && Q == tlsf_ensure_post(
                                d,
                                s,
                                lim,
                                top,
                                xs,
                                hd,
                                fl,
                                sb,
                                bl,
                                before,
                                fp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_spec_call`

```
∀ (inst : Inst) (d s top fl : W32) (pop push ensure_idx lim : Num)
  (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)

```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_specs`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32)
  (pop push ensure_idx k : Num)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, ensure_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_ensure_code(d, pop, push))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  specs_ok(k, tlsf_ensure_spec(inst, d, pop, push, ensure_idx), fs, tabs, inst)
```

lemma `tlsf_ensure_all`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d s top fl : W32)
  (pop push ensure_idx lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (before : Heap)
  (fp : GProp) (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, ensure_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_ensure_code(d, pop, push))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_ensure_pre(
             d,
             s,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             before,
             fp,
             args,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    [Call(ensure_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_ensure_post(
             d,
             s,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             before,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_prev_body_parts`

```
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_prev_body(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_prev_args(d, pop, push),
    APPEND([Call(pop)], tlsf_free_prev_write(d, pop, push)))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_next_body_parts`

```
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_next_body(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_next_args(d, pop, push),
    APPEND([Call(pop)], tlsf_free_next_write(d, pop, push)))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_prev_parts`

```
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_prev(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_prev_test(d, pop, push),
    [If(Tbv(NONE), tlsf_free_prev_body(d, pop, push), NIL)])
```

lemma `tlsf_free_next_parts`

```
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_next(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_next_test(d, pop, push),
    [If(Tbv(NONE), tlsf_free_next_body(d, pop, push), NIL)])
```

lemma `tlsf_free_code_parts`

```
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_clear(d, pop, push),
    APPEND(
      tlsf_free_prev(d, pop, push),
      APPEND(tlsf_free_next(d, pop, push), tlsf_free_publish(d, pop, push))))
```

definition `tlsf_release`

```
tlsf_release((hd : (W32) -> W32), (m : W32))
  == tlsf_put(hd, m, ((hd : (W32) -> W32)((m : W32)) &₃₂ 4294967294w))
```

definition `tlsf_merge_size`

```
tlsf_merge_size((a : W32), (b : W32))
  == (tlsf_size((a : W32)) +₃₂ tlsf_size((b : W32)) +₃₂ 8w)
```

definition `tlsf_merge_header`

```
tlsf_merge_header((a : W32), (b : W32))
  == (tlsf_merge_size((a : W32), (b : W32)) |₃₂ (b : W32) &₃₂ 2w)
```

definition `tlsf_merge_headers`

```
tlsf_merge_headers((hd : (W32) -> W32), (m : W32), (r : W32))
  == tlsf_put(hd, m, tlsf_merge_header(hd(m), hd(r)))
```

definition `tlsf_free_geom`

```
tlsf_free_geom(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (m : W32))
  == tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, tlsf_mark(hd, m))
```

definition `tlsf_free_pending`

```
tlsf_free_pending(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (ys : List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (zs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
    && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
    && tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
    && (
         (
           pts(val(tlsf_top_cell((d : W32))), serialise_i32((top : W32)))
           * tlsf_regions(0w, (ys : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
           * pts(val((m : W32)), serialise_i32((hd : (W32) -> W32)(m)))
           * pts(
               val(((m : W32) +₃₂ 4w)),
               serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, (ys : List[W32]))))
           * tlsf_bytes(
               val((m : W32)) + 8,
               val(tlsf_size((hd : (W32) -> W32)(m))))
           * tlsf_regions((m : W32), (zs : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
           * tlsf_bins(
               (d : W32),
               (fl : W32),
               (sb : (Num) -> W32),
               (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])))(h)))
```

definition `tlsf_free_pre`

```
tlsf_free_pre(
  (d : W32),
  (m : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (args : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    args == [V_num(ConstInt32(m))]
    && ms == lim
    && MEM(m, xs)
    && tlsf_used(hd(m))
    && (
         (
           tlsf_large(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]))
           * tlsf_bytes(
               val((m : W32)) + 8,
               val(tlsf_size((hd : (W32) -> W32)(m))))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))
```

definition `tlsf_free_post`

```
tlsf_free_post(
  (d : W32),
  (m : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))]
    && ms == lim
    && (
         ∃ top2 : W32,
           ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
             ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl2 : W32,
                 ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     ∃ r : W32,
                       MEM(r, xs2)
                       && !tlsf_used(hd2(r))
                       && val(r) <= val(m)
                       && val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) <= val(r) + 8 + val(
                            tlsf_size(hd2(r)))
                       && (
                            ∀ x : W32,
                              MEM(x, xs)
                              && !(x == m)
                              && tlsf_used(hd(x)) → MEM(x, xs2)
                              && hd2(x) == hd(x))
                       && (
                            (
                              tlsf_large(
                                (d : W32),
                                (lim : Num),
                                top2,
                                xs2,
                                hd2,
                                fl2,
                                sb2,
                                bl2)
                              * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h))))
```

definition `tlsf_free_pair`

```
tlsf_free_pair(
  (d : W32),
  (top : W32),
  (ys : List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (r : W32),
  (zs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  pts(val(tlsf_top_cell((d : W32))), serialise_i32((top : W32)))
  * tlsf_regions(0w, (ys : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
  * pts(val((m : W32)), serialise_i32((hd : (W32) -> W32)(m)))
  * pts(val(((m : W32) +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, (ys : List[W32]))))
  * tlsf_bytes(val((m : W32)) + 8, val(tlsf_size((hd : (W32) -> W32)(m))))
  * pts(val((r : W32)), serialise_i32((hd : (W32) -> W32)(r)))
  * pts(val(((r : W32) +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32((m : W32)))
  * tlsf_bytes(val((r : W32)) + 8, val(tlsf_size((hd : (W32) -> W32)(r))))
  * tlsf_regions((r : W32), (zs : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
  * tlsf_bins(
      (d : W32),
      (fl : W32),
      (sb : (Num) -> W32),
      (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_end_append`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (p : W32),
  tlsf_end(p, APPEND(ys, zs)) == tlsf_end(tlsf_end(p, ys), zs)
```

definition `tlsf_free_left`

```
tlsf_free_left((ys : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
  == (ys == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(tlsf_end(0w, ys))))
```

definition `tlsf_free_right`

```
tlsf_free_right((zs : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
  == (zs == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(HD(zs))))
```

definition `tlsf_free_covers`

```
tlsf_free_covers(
  (m0 : W32),
  (hd0 : (W32) -> W32),
  (m : W32),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
  val(m) <= val(m0)
  && val(m0) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd0(m0))) <= val(m) + 8 + val(
       tlsf_size(hd(m))))
```

definition `tlsf_free_live`

```
tlsf_free_live(
  (xs0 : List[W32]),
  (hd0 : (W32) -> W32),
  (m0 : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
  ∀ x : W32,
    MEM(x, xs0)
    && !(x == m0)
    && tlsf_used(hd0(x)) → MEM(x, xs)
    && hd(x) == hd0(x))
```

definition `tlsf_free_work`

```
tlsf_free_work(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (m0 : W32),
  (xs0 : List[W32]),
  (hd0 : (W32) -> W32),
  (fp : GProp),
  (left : Bool),
  (right : Bool)) == (
  (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
  (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    vs == NIL
    && ms == lim
    && (
         ∃ top : W32,
           ∃ ys : List[W32],
             ∃ m : W32,
               ∃ zs : List[W32],
                 ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
                   ∃ fl : W32,
                     ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                       ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                         ∃ l1 : Value,
                           ∃ l2 : Value,
                             lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2]
                             && tlsf_free_geom(
                                  d,
                                  lim,
                                  top,
                                  APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                                  hd,
                                  m)
                             && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
                             && tlsf_bins_match(
                                  APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                                  tlsf_mark(hd, m),
                                  bl)
                             && tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
                             && tlsf_free_live(
                                  xs0,
                                  hd0,
                                  m0,
                                  APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                                  hd)
                             && (!left || tlsf_free_left(ys, hd))
                             && (!right || tlsf_free_right(zs, hd))
                             && (
                                  (
                                    tlsf_free_pending(
                                      (d : W32),
                                      (lim : Num),
                                      top,
                                      ys,
                                      m,
                                      zs,
                                      hd,
                                      fl,
                                      sb,
                                      bl)
                                    * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h))))
```

lemma `tlsf_release_fields`

```
∀ (h : W32),
  tlsf_size((h &₃₂ 4294967294w)) == tlsf_size(h)
  && tlsf_last((h &₃₂ 4294967294w)) == tlsf_last(h)
  && !tlsf_used((h &₃₂ 4294967294w))
```

lemma `tlsf_layout_fields`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, xs) → tlsf_size(hd(x)) == tlsf_size(nh(x))
       && tlsf_last(hd(x)) == tlsf_last(nh(x))
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd) == tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, nh)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_bins_transport`

```
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. ∀ x : W32,
       (MEM(x, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(x))) == (MEM(x, ys) && !tlsf_used(nh(x)))
  3. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(x)) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  tlsf_bins_match(ys, nh, bl)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_mark_fields`

```
∀ (hd : (W32) -> W32) (m x : W32),
  tlsf_size(tlsf_mark(hd, m, x)) == tlsf_size(hd(x))
  && tlsf_last(tlsf_mark(hd, m, x)) == tlsf_last(hd(x))
  && tlsf_used(tlsf_mark(hd, m, x)) == (x == m || tlsf_used(hd(x)))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_release_fields`

```
∀ (hd : (W32) -> W32) (m x : W32),
  tlsf_size(tlsf_release(hd, m, x)) == tlsf_size(hd(x))
  && tlsf_last(tlsf_release(hd, m, x)) == tlsf_last(hd(x))
  && tlsf_used(tlsf_release(hd, m, x)) == (!(x == m) && tlsf_used(hd(x)))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_layout_mark`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top m : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, tlsf_mark(hd, m))
    == tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_geom_facts`

```
∀ (d top m : W32) (lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, xs, hd, m) == (
    val(d) <= 4294965088
    && lim <= 4294967296
    && MOD(lim, 65536) == 0
    && !(xs == NIL)
    && tlsf_layout(0w, tlsf_origin(d), lim, top, xs, hd)
    && tlsf_coalesced(xs, tlsf_mark(hd, m)))
```

lemma `tlsf_layout_prev`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p q top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. !(xs == NIL)
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd) == tlsf_layout(q, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
```

lemma `tlsf_layout_contract_head`

```
∀ (zs : List[W32]) (p top m r : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs)), hd)
  2. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(m))), 8) == 0
  4. tlsf_last(nh(m)) == tlsf_last(hd(r))
  5. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, if zs == NIL { m } else { top }, CONS(m, zs), nh)
```

lemma `tlsf_layout_contract`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (p top m r : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  2. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(m))), 8) == 0
  4. tlsf_last(nh(m)) == tlsf_last(hd(r))
  5. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  tlsf_layout(
    p,
    a,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { m } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    nh)
```

lemma `tlsf_coalesced_focus`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32),

    tlsf_coalesced(ys, hd)
    && tlsf_coalesced(zs, hd)
    && (ys == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(tlsf_end(0w, ys))) || tlsf_used(hd(m)))
    && (zs == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(m)) || tlsf_used(hd(HD(zs)))))
```

lemma `tlsf_coalesced_contract`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r : W32) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  2. tlsf_used(nh(m))
  3. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → tlsf_used(hd(x)) == tlsf_used(nh(x))
then
  tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), nh)
```

lemma `tlsf_merge_aligned`

```
∀ (a b : Num)
if
  1. MOD(a, 8) == 0
  2. MOD(b, 8) == 0
then
  MOD(a + b + 8, 8) == 0
```

lemma `tlsf_merge_size_fields`

```
∀ (a b : W32)
if
  1. val(tlsf_size(a)) + val(tlsf_size(b)) + 8 < 4294967296
  2. MOD(val(tlsf_size(a)), 8) == 0
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(b)), 8) == 0
then
  val(tlsf_merge_size(a, b)) == val(tlsf_size(a)) + val(tlsf_size(b)) + 8
  && MOD(val(tlsf_merge_size(a, b)), 8) == 0
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_size(a, b)) == tlsf_merge_size(a, b)
```

lemma `tlsf_merge_header_fields`

```
∀ (a b : W32)
if
  1. val(tlsf_size(a)) + val(tlsf_size(b)) + 8 < 4294967296
  2. MOD(val(tlsf_size(a)), 8) == 0
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(b)), 8) == 0
then
  tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_header(a, b)) == tlsf_merge_size(a, b)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_merge_header(a, b))
  && tlsf_last(tlsf_merge_header(a, b)) == tlsf_last(b)
  && val(tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_header(a, b)))
       == val(tlsf_size(a)) + val(tlsf_size(b)) + 8
```

lemma `tlsf_free_begin_model`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (m d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
then
  tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, xs, tlsf_release(hd, m), m)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_release(hd, m, m))
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_release(hd, m, m)) == tlsf_size(hd(m))
  && tlsf_bins_match(xs, tlsf_mark(tlsf_release(hd, m), m), bl)
  && ∀ x : W32, !(x == m) → tlsf_release(hd, m, x) == hd(x)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_merge_live`

  2. active == m || active == r
  3. val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  4. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
then
