
lemma `tlsf_free_work_fold`

```
∀ (d m0 top m fl : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs0 ys zs : List[W32])
  (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (fp : GProp) (left right : Bool) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 : Value) (vs lc gs : List[Value])
  (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  4. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
  5. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  6. !left || tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
  7. !right || tlsf_free_right(zs, hd)
  8. st(
       NIL,
       [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
       (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         ms == lim
         && (
              (
                tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
                * fp(gs, ms))(h)),
       vs,
       lc,
       gs,
       ms,
       h)
then
  tlsf_free_work(d, lim, m0, xs0, hd0, fp, left, right, vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_pair_facts`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  2. lim <= 4294967296
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)
  && tlsf_block_ok(val(r), lim, r, hd)
  && val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  && !tlsf_last(hd(m))
  && tlsf_last(hd(r)) == (zs == NIL)
  && !MEM(m, ys)
  && !MEM(m, zs)
  && !MEM(r, ys)
  && !MEM(r, zs)
  && !(m == r)
  && val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + val(tlsf_size(hd(r))) + 8 < 4294967296
```

lemma `tlsf_free_pair_geometry`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r d top active : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, active)
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)
  && tlsf_block_ok(val(r), lim, r, hd)
  && val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  && !tlsf_last(hd(m))
  && tlsf_last(hd(r)) == (zs == NIL)
  && !MEM(m, ys)
  && !MEM(m, zs)
  && !MEM(r, ys)
  && !MEM(r, zs)
  && !(m == r)
  && val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + val(tlsf_size(hd(r))) + 8 < 4294967296
```

lemma `tlsf_free_merge_bins`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r a b : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))),
       tlsf_mark(tlsf_mark(hd, a), b),
       bl)
  2. a == m && b == r || a == r && b == m
  3. !(m == r)
  4. !MEM(r, ys)
  5. !MEM(r, zs)
then
  tlsf_bins_match(
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_mark(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r), m),
    bl)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_bin_decompose`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])

if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, tlsf_mark(hd, a), bl)
  2. !(a == b)
  3. MEM(b, xs)
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(b))
  5. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(b)))
then
  ∃ (us vs : List[W32]),
    bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(b)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(b))) == APPEND(us, CONS(b, vs))
```

```
  3. MEM(b, xs)
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(b))

then

```

lemma `tlsf_free_merge_model`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r active d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, active)
  2. active == m || active == r
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
then
  tlsf_free_geom(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { m } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r),
    m)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m))
  && val(tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m)))
       == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  && tlsf_last(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m)) == tlsf_last(hd(r))
  && ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → hd(x) == tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, x)
  && !(m == r)
  && !MEM(m, ys)
  && !MEM(m, zs)
  && !MEM(r, ys)
  && !MEM(r, zs)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_merge_prev_work`

```
∀ (xs0 ys zs us vs : List[W32]) (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (m0 m r d top : W32)
  (lim : Num) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, r)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), tlsf_mark(hd, r), bl)
  5. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, r, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  7. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))
then
  tlsf_free_geom(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { m } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r),
    m)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m))
  && tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
       tlsf_mark(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r), m),
       tlsf_pop_bl(hd(m), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))
  && tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_live(
       xs0,
       hd0,
       m0,
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
       tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_left(ys, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_merge_next_work`

```
∀ (xs0 ys zs us vs : List[W32]) (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (m0 m r d top : W32)
  (lim : Num) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, m)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  5. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  7. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(r)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(r))) == APPEND(us, CONS(r, vs))
  8. tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
then
  tlsf_free_geom(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { m } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r),
    m)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m))
  && tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
       tlsf_mark(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r), m),
       tlsf_pop_bl(hd(r), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))
  && tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_live(
       xs0,
       hd0,
       m0,
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
       tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_left(ys, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_right(zs, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_join_bytes`

```
∀ (a n b : Num) (x y : W32) (R : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. (
       tlsf_bytes(a, n)
       * pts(a + n, serialise_i32(x))
       * pts(a + n + 4, serialise_i32(y))
       * tlsf_bytes(a + n + 8, b)
       * R)(h)
then
  (tlsf_bytes(a, n + 8 + b) * R)(h)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_if_taken`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp Q : SAssn)
  (lc : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (body : List[B_e])
  (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. !(c == 0w)
  2. ∀ ls2 : List[SAssn],
       sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, st(NIL, lc, R), body, Q, ls2)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st([V_num(ConstInt32(c))], lc, R),
    [If(Tbv(NONE), body, NIL)],
    Q,
    labels)
```

```
  (labels : List[SAssn])
if

  2. ∀ ls2 : List[SAssn],

then

    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_prev_boundary_test`

```
∀ (ys qs zs ts : List[W32]) (m p n d top fl : W32) (pop push lim : Num)
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. true
  2. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(NIL, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(NIL, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, NIL, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_prev_test(d, pop, push),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32((m +₃₂ 4w))), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, NIL, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_prev_neighbour_test`

```
∀ (ys qs zs ts : List[W32]) (m p n d top fl : W32) (pop push lim : Num)
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. !(p == 0w)
  2. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(APPEND(qs, [p]), CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(APPEND(qs, [p]), CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(qs, [p]),
                 m,
                 zs,
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_prev_test(d, pop, push),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(wasm_bool(!tlsf_used(hd(p)))))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32((m +₃₂ 4w))), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(qs, [p]),
                 m,
                 zs,
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))))
```

example `tlsf_free_prev_last_write_raw`

```
∀ (d m r hm hr top : W32) (pop push : Num) (l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. !((hr &₃₂ 2w) == 0w)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(r)), V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hm))
          * pts(val(r), serialise_i32(hr))
          * pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(top))
          * fp(gs, ms))),
    tlsf_free_prev_write(d, pop, push),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(hm))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(
            val(m),
            serialise_i32(
              (
                (
                  hm
                  &₃₂ 3w
                      |₃₂ (hm &₃₂ 4294967292w)
                          +₃₂ (hr &₃₂ 4294967292w)
                          +₃₂ 8w)
                &₃₂ 4294967293w |₃₂ 2w)))
          * pts(val(r), serialise_i32(hr))
          * pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(m))
          * fp(gs, ms))))
```

example `tlsf_free_pop_invoke_g`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m hd fl : W32) (pop : Num)
  (lc0 : List[Value]) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (us vs : List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd))
  2. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd), tlsf_slot_of(hd)) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    tlsf_proved_spec(
      sfunc_ind(inst, pop),

    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      false,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m))],
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd))
          * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
          * fp(gs, ms))),

      NIL,

      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd))
          * pts(val((m +₃₂ 8w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_prev(us)))
          * pts(val((m +₃₂ 12w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_hd(vs)))
          * tlsf_bins(
```

lemma `tlsf_free_begin`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m d top fl : W32) (pop push lim : Num)
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, bl)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_clear(d, pop, push),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 ys,
                 m,
                 zs,
                 tlsf_release(hd, m),
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_pop_prev_pair`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m r top fl : W32)
  (pop lim : Num) (ys zs us vs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (lc0 : List[Value])
  (fp : GProp)
if

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  2. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, r)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
  5. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), tlsf_mark(hd, r), bl)
  6. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(

      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(ys, [m]),
                 r,
                 zs,
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    [Call(pop)],
    st(
      NIL,
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pair(
                 d,
                 top,
                 ys,
                 m,
                 r,
                 zs,
                 hd,
                 tlsf_pop_fl(hd(m), fl, sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_sb(hd(m), sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_bl(hd(m), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_merge_close`

```
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (d top m r fl : W32) (lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), nh, m)
  2. !tlsf_used(nh(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(nh, m), bl)
  4. val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  5. val((r +₃₂ 4w)) == val(r) + 4
  6. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  7. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → nh(x) == hd(x)
  8. (
       pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(top))
       * tlsf_regions(0w, ys, hd)
       * pts(val(m), serialise_i32(nh(m)))
       * pts(val((m +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(0w, ys)))
       * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
       * pts(val(r), serialise_i32(hd(r)))
       * pts(val((r +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(m))
       * tlsf_bytes(val(r) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(r))))
       * tlsf_regions(m, zs, hd)
       * tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)
       * fp)(h)
then
  (tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, nh, fl, sb, bl) * fp)(h)
```

```
if

  3. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, [m, r]), tlsf_mark(tlsf_mark(hd, r), m), bl)
then
  sl_triple(

      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(r)), V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pair(d, top, ys, m, r, NIL, hd, fl, sb, bl)

    st(

                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))))
```

```
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  2. tlsf_free_geom(
       d,
       lim,
       top,
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, CONS(n, ts)))),
       hd,
       r)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
  5. tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, CONS(n, ts)))),
       tlsf_mark(hd, r),
       bl)
  6. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(r)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(ys, [m]),
                 r,
                 CONS(n, ts),
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_prev_body(d, pop, push),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(hd(m)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 ys,
                 m,
                 CONS(n, ts),
                 tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r),
                 tlsf_pop_fl(hd(m), fl, sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_sb(hd(m), sb, APPEND(us, vs)),
                 tlsf_pop_bl(hd(m), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_start`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (ys zs : List[W32]) (m d top fl : W32)
  (pop push lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, bl)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_clear(d, pop, push),
    tlsf_free_work(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, fp, false, false),
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_publish_call`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m top fl : W32)
  (push lim : Num) (ys zs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (lc0 : List[Value]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  5. tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_right(zs, hd)
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m))],
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    [Call(push)],
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                 hd,
                 tlsf_push_fl(hd(m), fl),
                 tlsf_push_sb(hd(m), sb),
                 tlsf_push_bl(hd(m), m, bl))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    NIL)
```

```
  6. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(qs, [m, p]), hd)
  7. tlsf_free_left(qs, hd)
  8. !tlsf_used(hd(p))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, qs, m, [p], hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_next(d, pop, push),
    tlsf_free_work(d, lim, m0, xs0, hd0, fp, true, true),
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_next_interior_path`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (m0 m p n d top fl : W32) (xs0 qs zs ts : List[W32])
  (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (pop push lim : Num) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  2. tlsf_free_geom(
       d,
       lim,
       top,
       APPEND(qs, CONS(m, CONS(p, CONS(n, ts)))),
       hd,
       m)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(qs, CONS(m, CONS(p, CONS(n, ts)))),
       tlsf_mark(hd, m),
       bl)
  5. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(qs, CONS(m, CONS(p, CONS(n, ts)))), hd)
  7. tlsf_free_left(qs, hd)
  8. !tlsf_used(hd(p))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 qs,
                 m,
                 CONS(p, CONS(n, ts)),
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_next(d, pop, push),
    tlsf_free_work(d, lim, m0, xs0, hd0, fp, true, true),
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_finish_focused`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (d m0 top0 fl0 top m fl : W32) (pop push lim : Num)
  (xs0 ys zs : List[W32]) (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb0 sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl0 bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp) (l1 l2 : Value)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  5. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  7. tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
  8. tlsf_free_right(zs, hd)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_publish(d, pop, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_free_post(
        d,
        m0,
        lim,
        top0,
        xs0,
        hd0,
        fl0,
        sb0,
        bl0,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_body_focused`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m top fl : W32)
  (pop push lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  3. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  4. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  5. MEM(m, xs)
  6. tlsf_used(hd(m))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_free_post(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp, vs, gs, ms, h),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_free_post(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp, vs, gs, ms, h),
    [
      (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
      (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        tlsf_free_post(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp, vs, gs, ms, h)])
```

lemma `tlsf_free_body`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m top fl : W32)

if

        tlsf_free_post(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp, vs, gs, ms, h)])
```

definition `tlsf_free_spec`

```
tlsf_free_spec(
  (inst : Inst),
  (d : W32),
  (pop : Num),
  (push : Num),
  (free_idx : Num),
  (a : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  a == sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx)
  && (
       ∃ m : W32,
         ∃ lim : Num,
           ∃ top : W32,
             ∃ xs : List[W32],
               ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
                 ∃ fl : W32,
                   ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                     ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                       ∃ fp : GProp,
                         P == tlsf_free_pre(
                           d,
                           m,
                           lim,
                           top,
                           xs,
                           hd,
                           fl,
                           sb,
                           bl,
                           fp)
                         && Q == tlsf_free_post(
                              d,
                              m,
                              lim,
                              top,
                              xs,
                              hd,
                              fl,
                              sb,
                              bl,
                              fp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_spec_call`

```
∀ (inst : Inst) (d m top fl : W32) (pop push free_idx lim : Num)
  (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp),
  tlsf_free_spec(
    inst,
    d,
    pop,
    push,
    free_idx,
    sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx),
    tlsf_free_pre(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp),
    tlsf_free_post(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp))
```

lemma `tlsf_free_specs`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32)
  (pop push free_idx k : Num)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  specs_ok(k, tlsf_free_spec(inst, d, pop, push, free_idx), fs, tabs, inst)
```

lemma `tlsf_free_all`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m top fl : W32)
  (pop push free_idx lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
  (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_free_pre(
             d,
             m,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             fp,
             args,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    [Call(free_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_free_post(
             d,
             m,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)
```

```
  i32.const 1908
  i32.add
  local.get 0
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
```

definition `tlsf_initialize_work`

```
tlsf_initialize_work(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (h0 : W32),
  (published : Bool),
  (top : W32),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && (
         (
           pts(val(tlsf_top_cell((d : W32))), serialise_i32((top : W32)))
           * pts(
               val(tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32))),
               serialise_i32((h0 : W32)))
           * pts(
               val((tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32)) +₃₂ 4w)),
               serialise_i32(0w))
           * tlsf_spare(
               tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32)),
               tlsf_initialize_header(d, (lim : Num)))
           * pts(val(tlsf_base((d : W32))) + 1912, REPLICATE(264, 0w))
           * if (published : Bool) {
               tlsf_bins(
                 (d : W32),
                 tlsf_push_fl(tlsf_initialize_header(d, (lim : Num)), 0w),
                 tlsf_push_sb(
                   tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                   (f : Num) => 0w),
                 tlsf_push_bl(
                   tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                   tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                   (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL)) } else {
               (
                 pts(
                   val((tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32)) +₃₂ 8w)),
                   serialise_i32(0w))
                 * pts(
                     val((tlsf_initialize_origin((d : W32)) +₃₂ 12w)),
                     serialise_i32(0w))
                 * tlsf_bins(
                     (d : W32),
                     0w,
                     (f : Num) => 0w,
                     (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL)) }
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))
```

lemma `tlsf_initialize_publish_work`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32) (push lim : Num)
  (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. lim <= 4294967296
  3. MOD(lim, 65536) == 0
  4. val(tlsf_base(d)) + 2208 <= lim
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_initialize_origin(d))), l1, l2],
      tlsf_initialize_work(
        d,
        lim,
        tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
        false,
        0w,
        fp)),
    tlsf_initialize_publish(d, push),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_initialize_origin(d))), l1, l2],
      tlsf_initialize_work(
        d,
        lim,
        tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
        true,
        0w,
        fp)),
    NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_initialize_zero_ready`

```
∀ (d : W32) (lim ms : Num) (fp : GProp) (gs : List[Value]) (h : Heap)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. lim <= 4294967296
  3. MOD(lim, 65536) == 0
  4. val(tlsf_base(d)) + 2208 <= lim
  5. ms == lim
  6. (tlsf_initialize_zero(d, lim) * fp(gs, ms))(h)
then

```

lemma `tlsf_initialize_old_pages`

```
∀ (lim : Num)
if
  1. lim <= 4294967296
then
  (val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(DIV(lim, 65536)))
    == DIV(lim, 65536)
  && DIV(lim, 65536) <= 65536
```

lemma `tlsf_initialize_growth_test`

```
∀ (d : W32) (lim : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_initialize_valid(d, lim)
then
  word_ugt(tlsf_initialize_required(d), word(DIV(lim, 65536)))
    == (lim < tlsf_initialize_pages(d) * 65536)
```

lemma `tlsf_initialize_growth_delta`

```
∀ (d : W32) (lim : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_initialize_valid(d, lim)
  2. word_ugt(tlsf_initialize_required(d), word(DIV(lim, 65536)))
then
  val((tlsf_initialize_required(d) −₃₂ word(DIV(lim, 65536))))
    == tlsf_initialize_pages(d) - DIV(lim, 65536)
  && lim + val((tlsf_initialize_required(d) −₃₂ word(DIV(lim, 65536)))) * 65536
       == tlsf_initialize_pages(d) * 65536
  && DIV(lim, 65536) + val(
       (tlsf_initialize_required(d) −₃₂ word(DIV(lim, 65536)))) <= 65536
```

lemma `tlsf_initialize_limit_cases`

```
∀ (d : W32) (lim : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_initialize_valid(d, lim)
then
  word_ugt(tlsf_initialize_required(d), word(DIV(lim, 65536))) → tlsf_initialize_limit(
    d,
    lim)
    == tlsf_initialize_pages(d) * 65536
  && !word_ugt(tlsf_initialize_required(d), word(DIV(lim, 65536))) → tlsf_initialize_limit(
       d,
       lim)
       == lim
```

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32) (push : Num)

if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],

         ∀ gs : List[Value],

```

```

if

       inst,
```

```
       tlsf_initialize_code(d, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),

  sl_abort_m(

      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        tlsf_initialize_pre(d, lim, before, fp, NIL, gs, ms, h)),
    [Call(j)],
    st(
      NIL,

      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
```

lemma `tlsf_initialize_run`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32) (j push lim : Num)
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp) (lc0 vs : List[Value]) (fr : HProp)
  (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. tlsf_initialize_valid(d, lim)
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, j), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf(NIL, NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_initialize_code(d, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  4. keep(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       lift(
         st(
           NIL,
           lc0,
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
             tlsf_initialize_pre(d, lim, before, fp, NIL, gs, ms, h)),
         fr),
       s,
       f,
       vs)
  5. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Call(j))])),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (res : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, res)
    && keep(
         fs,
         tabs,
         inst,
         lift(
           st(
             NIL,
             lc0,
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
               tlsf_initialize_post(d, lim, before, fp, NIL, gs, ms, h)),
           fr),
         s2,
         f2,
         res)
or
  es2 == [Trap]
  && keep(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       lift(tlsf_initialize_abort(d, lim, before, fp), fr),
       s2,
       f2,
       NIL)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)
```

## Small-block pages (tlsf_small_*.mbt)

definition `tlsf_small_total`

```
tlsf_small_total((s : Num)) == DIV(1056, 8 + s)
```

definition `tlsf_small_slot`

```
tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num))
  == word(val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * i)
```

definition `tlsf_small_slots`

```
tlsf_small_slots((p : W32), (s : Num), 0) == NIL
&& tlsf_small_slots((p : W32), (s : Num), SUC((n : Num)))
     == APPEND(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n), [tlsf_small_slot(p, s, n)])
```

definition `tlsf_small_used`

```
tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32]))
  == LENGTH(cached) + LENGTH(live)
```

definition `tlsf_small_partition`

```
tlsf_small_partition(
  (p : W32),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  (
    ∀ b : W32,
      tlsf_count(b, APPEND(loc, APPEND(cached, live))) == (
        if MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) { 1 } else {
          0 }))
  && LENGTH(loc) + tlsf_small_used(cached, live) == tlsf_small_total(s))
```

definition `tlsf_small_page_ok`

```
tlsf_small_page_ok(
  (lim : Num),
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  !(p == 0w)
  && MOD(val(p), 8) == 0
  && lim <= 4294967296
  && val(p) + 8 + cap <= lim
  && 1080 <= cap
  && 8 <= s
  && s <= 256
  && MOD(s, 8) == 0
  && tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live))
```

definition `tlsf_small_lists_ok`

```
tlsf_small_lists_ok(
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (
    ∀ p : W32,
      MEM(p, ps) → tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
      && 0 < tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
      && (
           ∀ b : W32,
             MEM(b, cached(p)) → tlsf_count(b, fast(DIV(sz(p), 8))) == 1)
      && (
           tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) → tlsf_count(
             p,
             partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))
             == 1))
  && (
       ∀ j : Num,
         ∀ b : W32,
           j < 33
           && MEM(b, fast(j)) → (
                ∃ p : W32, MEM(p, ps) && sz(p) == 8 * j && MEM(b, cached(p))))
  && (
       ∀ j : Num,
         ∀ p : W32,
           j < 33
           && MEM(p, partial(j)) → MEM(p, ps)
           && sz(p) == 8 * j
           && 0 < tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
           && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p))))
```

definition `tlsf_small_backing`

```
tlsf_small_backing(
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (lim : Num)) == (
  ∀ p : W32,
    MEM(p, ps) → MEM(p, xs)
    && tlsf_used(hd(p))
    && tlsf_small_page_ok(
         lim,
         p,
         val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
         sz(p),
         loc(p),
         cached(p),
         live(p)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_count_cons`

```
∀ (b a : W32) (xs : List[W32]),
  tlsf_count(b, CONS(a, xs)) == (if a == b { 1 } else { 0 }) + tlsf_count(b, xs)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_count_append`

```
∀ (b : W32) (xs ys : List[W32]),
  tlsf_count(b, APPEND(xs, ys)) == tlsf_count(b, xs) + tlsf_count(b, ys)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_partition_checkout`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, CONS(b, cached), live)
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, CONS(b, live))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_partition_release`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, CONS(b, live))
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, CONS(b, loc), cached, live)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_partition_export`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, CONS(b, loc), NIL, live)
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, NIL, loc, CONS(b, live))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_accounting`

```
∀ (p : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
then
  tlsf_small_used(cached, live) <= tlsf_small_total(s)
  && (tlsf_small_used(cached, live) < tlsf_small_total(s)) == !(loc == NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_reclaimable`

```
∀ (cached live : List[W32]),
  (tlsf_small_used(cached, live) == 0) == (cached == NIL && live == NIL)
```

definition `tlsf_small_head`

```
tlsf_small_head((xs : List[W32])) == (if xs == NIL { 0w } else { HD(xs) })
```

definition `tlsf_small_links`

```
tlsf_small_links(NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_links(CONS((b : W32), (bs : List[W32]))) == (
     pts(val((b : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((bs : List[W32]))))
     * tlsf_small_links((bs : List[W32])))
```

definition `tlsf_small_partial_links`

```
tlsf_small_partial_links((prev : W32), NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_partial_links((prev : W32), CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]))) == (
     pts(val((p : W32)) + 24, serialise_i32((prev : W32)))
     * pts(
         val((p : W32)) + 28,
         serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((ps : List[W32]))))
     * tlsf_small_partial_links((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])))
```

definition `tlsf_small_slot_heap`

```
tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32]), (i : Num)) == (
  pts(val(tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num))), serialise_i32(4w))
  * pts(
      val(tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num))) + 4,
      serialise_i32(p))
  * (
      if MEM(
        tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num)),
        (live : List[W32])) { emp } else {
        tlsf_bytes(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 12, s - 4) })
  * emp)
```

definition `tlsf_small_page_heap`

```
tlsf_small_page_heap(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  pts(val((p : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(word((s : Num))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total((s : Num)))))
  * pts(
      val((p : W32)) + 16,
      serialise_i32(
        word(tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 20, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((loc : List[W32]))))
  * (
      if tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])) < tlsf_small_total(
        (s : Num)) { emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val((p : W32)) + 24, 8) })
  * tlsf_istar(
      tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32])),
      tlsf_small_total(s))
  * tlsf_small_links((loc : List[W32]))
  * tlsf_bytes(
      val((p : W32)) + 32 + (8 + (s : Num)) * tlsf_small_total(s),
      (cap : Num) - 24 - (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s))
  * emp)
```

definition `tlsf_small_pages_heap`

```
tlsf_small_pages_heap(
  NIL,
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]))
  == emp
&& tlsf_small_pages_heap(
     CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])),
     (hd : (W32) -> W32),
     (sz : (W32) -> Num),
     (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
     (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
     (live : (W32) -> List[W32])) == (
     tlsf_small_page_heap(
       (p : W32),
       val(tlsf_size((hd : (W32) -> W32)(p))),
       (sz : (W32) -> Num)(p),
       (loc : (W32) -> List[W32])(p),
       (cached : (W32) -> List[W32])(p),
       (live : (W32) -> List[W32])(p))
     * tlsf_small_pages_heap(
         (ps : List[W32]),
         (hd : (W32) -> W32),
         (sz : (W32) -> Num),
         (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
         (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
         (live : (W32) -> List[W32])))
```

definition `tlsf_small_table_item`

```
tlsf_small_table_item(
  (d : W32),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (j : Num)) == (
  pts(
    val(tlsf_base((d : W32))) + 1912 + 8 * (j : Num),
    serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((fast : (Num) -> List[W32])(j))))
  * pts(
      val(tlsf_base((d : W32))) + 1916 + 8 * (j : Num),
      serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((partial : (Num) -> List[W32])(j))))
  * tlsf_small_links((fast : (Num) -> List[W32])((j : Num)))
  * tlsf_small_partial_links(0w, (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])((j : Num)))
  * emp)
```

definition `tlsf_small_table`

```
tlsf_small_table(
  (d : W32),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
  == tlsf_istar(tlsf_small_table_item(d, fast, partial), 33)
```

definition `tlsf_small`

```
tlsf_small(
  (d : W32),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
    && (
         (
           tlsf_small_pages_heap(
             (ps : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (sz : (W32) -> Num),
             (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (live : (W32) -> List[W32]))
           * tlsf_small_table(
               (d : W32),
               (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
               (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])))(h)))
```

definition `tlsf_allocator`

```
tlsf_allocator(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
    && (
         (
           tlsf_large(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]))
           * tlsf_small(
               (d : W32),
               (hd : (W32) -> W32),
               (ps : List[W32]),
               (sz : (W32) -> Num),
               (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
               (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
               (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
               (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
               (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])))(h)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_slots_member`

```
∀ (n s : Num) (p b : W32),
  MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n))
    == (∃ i : Num, i < n && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_slots_length`

```
∀ (n s : Num) (p : W32), LENGTH(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n)) == n
```

lemma `tlsf_small_capacity`

```
∀ (s : Num)
if
  1. 8 <= s
  2. s <= 256
then
  4 <= tlsf_small_total(s)
  && tlsf_small_total(s) <= 66
  && (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s) <= 1056
```

lemma `tlsf_small_slot_bounds`

```
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) == val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * i
  && val(p) + 32 <= val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i))
  && val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 8 + s <= val(p) + 8 + cap
  && !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i) == 0w)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_slot_injective`

```
∀ (lim cap s i j : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. j < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  (tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i) == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j)) == (i == j)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_slots_disjoint`

```
∀ (lim cap s i j : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < j
  3. j < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 8 + s <= val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_partition_counts`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
then
  tlsf_count(b, loc) + tlsf_count(b, cached) + tlsf_count(b, live)
    == (if MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) { 1 } else { 0 })
```

lemma `tlsf_small_slot_exact`

```
∀ (p : W32) (s i : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  tlsf_count(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i), loc) + tlsf_count(
    tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i),
    cached) + tlsf_count(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i), live)
    == 1
```

lemma `tlsf_small_partial_exact`

```
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. 8 <= sz(p)
  4. sz(p) <= 256
  5. MOD(sz(p), 8) == 0
then
  MEM(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))
    == (tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p)))
  && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) → tlsf_count(
       p,
       partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))
       == 1
```

lemma `tlsf_small_backing_used`

```
∀ (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
then
  MEM(p, xs)
  && tlsf_used(hd(p))
  && 1080 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(p)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_cached_exact`

```
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (p b : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. MEM(b, cached(p))
then
  tlsf_count(b, fast(DIV(sz(p), 8))) == 1
```

lemma `tlsf_small_pairwise_separate`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (R : (W32, W32) -> Bool) (p q : W32)
if
  1. PAIRWISE(R, xs)
  2. MEM(p, xs)
  3. MEM(q, xs)
  4. !(p == q)
then
  R(p, q)
or
  R(q, p)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_backing_separate`

```
∀ (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (prev top p q : W32) (a lim : Num)
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_layout(prev, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
  4. MEM(q, ps)
  5. !(p == q)
then
  val(p) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(p))) <= val(q)
or
  val(q) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(q))) <= val(p)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_live_owned`

```
∀ (p : W32) (s i : Num) (live : List[W32])
if
  1. MEM(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i), live)
then
  tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live, i) == (
    pts(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)), serialise_i32(4w))
    * pts(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 4, serialise_i32(p)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_page_slot_focus`

```
∀ (p : W32) (cap s i : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  ∃ (rest : HProp),
    tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
      == (tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live, i) * rest)
```

lemma `tlsf_allocator_frame`

```
∀ (d top fl : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (client : HProp),
  (
    tlsf_allocator(
      d,
      lim,
      top,
      xs,
      hd,
      fl,
      sb,
      bl,
      ps,
      sz,
      loc,
      cached,
      live,
      fast,
      partial)
    * client) == (
    (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
      && (
           (
             tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
             * tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
             * client)(h)))
```

```
  MEM(p, xs)
  && tlsf_used(hd(p))
  && 1080 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(p)))
```

lemma `tlsf_allocator_page_not_in_bins`

```
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim f j : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)

  2. MEM(p, ps)
```

lemma `tlsf_allocator_client_write`

```
∀ (d top fl : W32) (lim a : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (client : HProp) (old bytes : List[Byte]) (mem : Mem)
if
  1. (
       tlsf_allocator(
         d,
         lim,
         top,
         xs,
         hd,
         fl,
         sb,
         bl,
         ps,
         sz,
         loc,
         cached,
         live,
         fast,
         partial)
       * pts(a, old)
       * client)(heap_of(mem))
  2. LENGTH(bytes) == LENGTH(old)
  3. !(old == NIL)
then
  (
    tlsf_allocator(
      d,
      lim,
      top,
      xs,
      hd,
      fl,
      sb,
      bl,
      ps,
      sz,
      loc,
      cached,
      live,
      fast,
      partial)
    * pts(a, bytes)
    * client)(heap_of(write_bytes(mem, a, bytes)))
```

```
∀ (d top fl : W32) (lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  tlsf_allocator(
```

lemma `tlsf_initialize_establishes_allocator`

```
∀ (d : W32) (lim ms : Num) (before h : Heap) (fp : GProp) (res gs : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_initialize_post(d, lim, before, fp, res, gs, ms, h)
then
  res == NIL
  && ms == tlsf_initialize_limit(d, lim)
  && (
       tlsf_allocator(
         d,
         ms,
         tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
         [tlsf_initialize_origin(d)],
         tlsf_initialize_headers(d, ms),
         tlsf_push_fl(tlsf_initialize_header(d, ms), 0w),
         tlsf_push_sb(tlsf_initialize_header(d, ms), (f : Num) => 0w),
         tlsf_push_bl(
           tlsf_initialize_header(d, ms),
           tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
           (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL),
         NIL,
         (p : W32) => 0,
         (p : W32) => NIL,
         (p : W32) => NIL,
         (p : W32) => NIL,
         (j : Num) => NIL,
         (j : Num) => NIL)
       * fp(gs, lim))(h)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_pages_transport`

```
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
if
  1. ∀ p : W32, MEM(p, ps) → tlsf_size(hd2(p)) == tlsf_size(hd(p))
then
  tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
    == tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd2, sz, loc, cached, live)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_transport`

```
∀ (d : W32) (ps : List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32)
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. ∀ p : W32, MEM(p, ps) → tlsf_size(hd2(p)) == tlsf_size(hd(p))
then
  tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
    == tlsf_small(d, hd2, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_backing_transport`

```
∀ (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim lim2 : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. lim <= lim2
  3. lim2 <= 4294967296
  4. ∀ p : W32,
       MEM(p, ps) → MEM(p, xs2)
       && tlsf_used(hd2(p))
       && tlsf_size(hd2(p)) == tlsf_size(hd(p))
then
  tlsf_small_backing(xs2, hd2, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim2)
```

```
      serialise_i32(tlsf_page_allocate_head(p, s, i)))

      s - 4)
  * emp)
```

```
tlsf_page_allocate_build(
  (p : W32),

  (s : Num),

  pts(val((p : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(word((s : Num))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total((s : Num)))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 16, serialise_i32((used0 : W32)))

  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 24, serialise_i32((prev0 : W32)))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 28, serialise_i32(0w))
  * tlsf_istar(tlsf_page_allocate_slot((p : W32), (s : Num)), (k : Num))
  * tlsf_bytes(

  * emp)

```

```
          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 20w)), serialise_i32(w2))
          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 28w)), serialise_i32(w3))

      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>

          pts(val((p +₃₂ 8w)), serialise_i32(s))
          * pts(
              val((p +₃₂ 12w)),
              serialise_i32(word_udiv(1056w, (s +₃₂ 8w))))
          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 20w)), serialise_i32((p +₃₂ 32w)))
          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 28w)), serialise_i32(0w))
          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 32w)), serialise_i32(4w))
          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 32w +₃₂ 4w)), serialise_i32(p))
          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 32w +₃₂ 8w)), serialise_i32(0w))
          * fp(gs, ms)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_total_word`

```
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 8 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 256
then
  !((s +₃₂ 8w) == 0w)
  && word_udiv(1056w, (s +₃₂ 8w)) == word(tlsf_small_total(val(s)))
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_bounds`

```
∀ (p : W32) (cap s k : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, s)
  2. k < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, k)) == val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * k
  && val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, k)) + 8 + s <= val(p) + 8 + cap
  && val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * k < 4294967296
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_slot_word`

```
∀ (p s : W32) (cap k : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, val(s))
  2. k < tlsf_small_total(val(s))
then
  (p +₃₂ 32w +₃₂ word(k) ×₃₂ (s +₃₂ 8w)) == tlsf_small_slot(p, val(s), k)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_compare`

```
∀ (k n : Num)
if
  1. k <= n
  2. n <= 66
then
  (word_ult : (W32, W32) -> Bool)(
    (word : (Num) -> W32)(k),
    (word : (Num) -> W32)(n))
    == (k < n)
```

definition `tlsf_page_allocate_work`

```
tlsf_page_allocate_work(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (k : Num),
  (used0 : W32),
  (prev0 : W32),
  (head : W32),
  (w0 : W32),
  (w1 : W32),
  (w2 : W32)) == (
  pts(val((p : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(word((s : Num))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total((s : Num)))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 16, serialise_i32((used0 : W32)))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 20, serialise_i32((head : W32)))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 24, serialise_i32((prev0 : W32)))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 28, serialise_i32(0w))
  * tlsf_istar(tlsf_page_allocate_slot((p : W32), (s : Num)), (k : Num))
  * pts(
      val(tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (k : Num))),
      serialise_i32((w0 : W32)))
  * pts(
      val(tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (k : Num))) + 4,
      serialise_i32((w1 : W32)))
  * pts(
      val(tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (k : Num))) + 8,
      serialise_i32((w2 : W32)))
  * tlsf_bytes(
      val(tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (k : Num))) + 12,
      s - 4)
  * tlsf_bytes(
      val((p : W32)) + 32 + (8 + (s : Num)) * SUC((k : Num)),
      (cap : Num) - 24 - (8 + s) * SUC(k))
  * emp)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_work_open`

```
∀ (p used0 prev0 : W32) (cap s k : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, s)
  2. k < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  tlsf_page_allocate_build(p, cap, s, k, used0, prev0) == (
    (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ w0 : W32,
        ∃ w1 : W32,
          ∃ w2 : W32,
            tlsf_page_allocate_work(
              p,
              cap,
              s,
              k,
              used0,
              prev0,
              tlsf_page_allocate_head(p, s, k),
              w0,
              w1,
              w2,
              h))
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_work_close`

```
∀ (p used0 prev0 : W32) (cap s k : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, s)

then
  tlsf_page_allocate_work(

    s,
    k,
    used0,

    tlsf_small_slot(p, s, k),
    4w,
    p,
    tlsf_page_allocate_head(p, s, k))
    == tlsf_page_allocate_build(p, cap, s, SUC(k), used0, prev0)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_step_build`

```
∀ (take_idx cap k : Num) (p s used0 prev0 : W32) (l4 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, val(s))
  2. k < tlsf_small_total(val(s))
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_page_allocate_head(p, val(s), k))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(k))), l4,
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(tlsf_small_total(val(s)))))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_page_allocate_build(p, cap, val(s), k, used0, prev0)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_page_allocate_step(take_idx),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(word(SUC(k))))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_slot(p, val(s), k))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(k))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_slot(p, val(s), k))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(tlsf_small_total(val(s)))))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_page_allocate_build(p, cap, val(s), SUC(k), used0, prev0)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_begin_build`

```
∀ (take_idx cap : Num) (p s : W32) (l2 l3 l4 l5 : Value) (fp : GProp)

       V_num(ConstInt32((p +₃₂ 32w))), V_num(ConstInt32(1w)), l4,
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_loop_build`

```
∀ (take_idx cap : Num) (p s used0 prev0 : W32) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, val(s))
then
  sl_triple(
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ k : Num,
        ∃ scratch : Value,
          1 <= k
          && k <= tlsf_small_total(val(s))
          && vs == NIL
          && lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
              V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_page_allocate_head(p, val(s), k))),
              V_num(ConstInt32(word(k))), scratch,

          && (

                 tlsf_page_allocate_build(p, cap, val(s), k, used0, prev0)
                 * fp(gs, ms)
                 * emp)(h)),
    tlsf_page_allocate_loop(take_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ scratch : Value,
        vs == NIL
        && lc == [
             V_num(ConstInt32(s)),
             V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
             V_num(
               ConstInt32(
                 tlsf_page_allocate_head(
                   p,
                   val(s),
                   tlsf_small_total(val(s))))),
             V_num(ConstInt32(word(tlsf_small_total(val(s))))),
             scratch,
             V_num(ConstInt32(word(tlsf_small_total(val(s)))))]
        && (
             (
               tlsf_page_allocate_build(
                 p,
                 cap,
                 val(s),
                 tlsf_small_total(val(s)),
                 used0,
                 prev0)
               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp)(h)))
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_retains_pages`

```
∀ (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_retains(xs, hd, xs2, hd2)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
then
  MEM(p, xs2)
  && tlsf_used(hd2(p))
  && hd2(p) == hd(p)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_backing`

```
∀ (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_retains(xs, hd, xs2, hd2)
  3. lim <= 4294967296
then
  tlsf_small_backing(xs2, hd2, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_small_transport`

```
∀ (d : W32) (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num)
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_retains(xs, hd, xs2, hd2)
then
  tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
    == tlsf_small(d, hd2, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_large_geometry`

```
∀ (d top p : W32) (lim s : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(p, xs)
  3. 1080 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(p)))
  4. 8 <= s
  5. s <= 256
  6. MOD(s, 8) == 0
then
  tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))), s)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_allocator_frame`

```
∀ (d top2 fl2 : W32) (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32)
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num)
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (sb2 : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (payload client : HProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_retains(xs, hd, xs2, hd2)
  3. lim <= 4294967296
then
  (
    tlsf_large(d, lim, top2, xs2, hd2, fl2, sb2, bl2)
    * payload
    * tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
    * client) == (
    tlsf_allocator(
      d,
      lim,
      top2,
      xs2,
      hd2,
      fl2,
      sb2,
      bl2,
      ps,
      sz,
      loc,
      cached,
      live,
      fast,
      partial)
    * payload
    * client)
```

definition `tlsf_page_allocate_pre`

```
tlsf_page_allocate_pre(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (s : W32),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(s))]
    && 8 <= val(s)
    && val(s) <= 256
    && MOD(val(s), 8) == 0
    && ms == lim
    && h == before
    && (
         (
           tlsf_allocator(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
             (ps : List[W32]),
             (sz : (W32) -> Num),
             (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
             (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))
```

definition `tlsf_page_allocate_reserved`

```
tlsf_page_allocate_reserved(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (s : W32),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && (
         res == [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))]
         && h == before
         && (
              (
                tlsf_allocator(
                  (d : W32),
                  (lim : Num),
                  (top : W32),
                  (xs : List[W32]),
                  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
                  (fl : W32),
                  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
                  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
                  (ps : List[W32]),
                  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
                * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h))
         || (
              ∃ p : W32,
                ∃ top2 : W32,
                  ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
                    ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
                      ∃ fl2 : W32,
                        ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                          ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                            res == [V_num(ConstInt32(p))]
                            && !(p == 0w)
                            && !MEM(p, ps)
                            && MEM(p, xs2)
                            && tlsf_used(hd2(p))
                            && tlsf_retains(xs, hd, xs2, hd2)
                            && tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(
                                 p,
                                 val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                 val(s))
                            && (
                                 (
                                   tlsf_bytes(
                                     val(p) + 8,
                                     val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))))
                                   * tlsf_allocator(
                                       (d : W32),
                                       (lim : Num),
                                       top2,
                                       xs2,
                                       hd2,
                                       fl2,
                                       sb2,
                                       bl2,
                                       (ps : List[W32]),
                                       (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                                       (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                                       (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
                                   * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))))
```

definition `tlsf_page_allocate_post`

```
tlsf_page_allocate_post(
  (d : W32),

  (top : W32),

  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (s : W32),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && (
         res == [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))]
         && h == before
         && (
              (
                tlsf_allocator(
                  (d : W32),
                  (lim : Num),
                  (top : W32),
                  (xs : List[W32]),
                  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
                  (fl : W32),
                  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
                  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
                  (ps : List[W32]),
                  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
                * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h))
         || (
              ∃ p : W32,
                ∃ top2 : W32,
                  ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
                    ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
                      ∃ fl2 : W32,
                        ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                          ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                            res == [V_num(ConstInt32(p))]
                            && !(p == 0w)
                            && !MEM(p, ps)
                            && MEM(p, xs2)
                            && tlsf_used(hd2(p))
                            && tlsf_retains(xs, hd, xs2, hd2)
                            && tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(
                                 p,
                                 val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                 val(s))
                            && (
                                 (
                                   tlsf_page_allocate_fresh(
                                     p,
                                     val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                     val((s : W32)))
                                   * tlsf_allocator(
                                       (d : W32),
                                       (lim : Num),
                                       top2,
                                       xs2,
                                       hd2,
                                       fl2,
                                       sb2,
                                       bl2,
                                       (ps : List[W32]),
                                       (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                                       (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                                       (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
                                   * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))))
```

program `tlsf_page_allocate_tail`

```
tlsf_page_allocate_tail((take_idx : Num)) ==
  local.tee 1
  i32.eqz
  if
    i32.const 0
    return
  end
  local.get 1
  i32.const 8
  i32.add
  local.get 0
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 1
  i32.const 12
  i32.add
  i32.const 1056
  local.get 0
  i32.const 8
  i32.add
  i32.div_u
  local.tee 5
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 1
  i32.const 28
  i32.add
  i32.const 0
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 1
  i32.const 32
  i32.add
  local.tee 2
  i32.const 8
  i32.add
  i32.const 0
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 2
  i32.const 4
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 2
  i32.const 4
  i32.add
  local.get 1
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 1
  i32.const 20
  i32.add
  local.get 2
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  i32.const 1
  local.set 3
  loop
    block
      block (result i32)
        local.get 3
        local.get 5
        i32.lt_u
        if
          local.get 1
          i32.const 32
          i32.add
          local.get 3
          local.get 0
          i32.const 8
          i32.add
          i32.mul
          i32.add
          local.tee 4
          i32.const 4
          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 4
          i32.const 4
          i32.add
          local.get 1
          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 4
          i32.const 8
          i32.add
          local.get 2
          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 1
          i32.const 20
          i32.add
          local.get 4
          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 4
          local.set 2
          local.get 3
          i32.const 1
          i32.add
          br 1
        end
        br 1
      end
      local.set 3
      br 1
    end
  end
  local.get 1
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_call_tail`

```
∀ (take_idx : Num),
  tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx) == APPEND(
    tlsf_page_allocate_call(take_idx),
    tlsf_page_allocate_tail(take_idx))
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_tail_success`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (take_idx cap : Num) (p s : W32) (l1 l2 l3 l4 l5 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, val(s))
  2. !(p == 0w)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), l1, l2, l3, l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 8, cap) * fp(gs, ms) * emp)),
    tlsf_page_allocate_tail(take_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      vs == [V_num(ConstInt32(p))]
      && ((tlsf_page_allocate_fresh(p, cap, val(s)) * fp(gs, ms))(h)),
    [rp])
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_take_post`

```
∀ (d top fl s : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before h : Heap) (fp : GProp) (res gs : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. 8 <= val(s)
  3. val(s) <= 256
  4. MOD(val(s), 8) == 0
  5. tlsf_take_post(
       d,
       1080w,
       lim,
       top,
       xs,
       hd,
       fl,
       sb,
       bl,
       before,
       (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
         (
           tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
           * fp(gs, ms)),
       res,
       gs,
       ms,
       h)
then
  tlsf_page_allocate_reserved(
    d,
    lim,
    top,
    xs,
    hd,
    fl,
    sb,
    bl,
    ps,
    sz,
    loc,
    cached,
    live,
    fast,
    partial,
    s,
    before,
    fp,
    res,
    gs,
    ms,
    h)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_or_g`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp P R Q : SAssn)
  (code : List[B_e]) (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, P, code, Q, labels)
  2. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, R, code, Q, labels)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      P(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) || R(vs, lc, gs, ms, h),
    code,
    Q,
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_prefix`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (pop push take_idx lim : Num)
  (d top fl s : W32) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp) (l1 l2 l3 l4 l5 : Value)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. 8 <= val(s)
  3. val(s) <= 256
  4. MOD(val(s), 8) == 0
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  6. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  7. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), l1, l2, l3, l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && h == before
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_page_allocate_call(take_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), l1, l2, l3, l4, l5]
      && tlsf_page_allocate_reserved(
           d,
           lim,
           top,
           xs,
           hd,
           fl,
           sb,
           bl,
           ps,
           sz,
           loc,
           cached,
           live,
           fast,
           partial,
           s,
           before,
           fp,
           vs,
           gs,
           ms,
           h),
    NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_body`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)
  (pop push take_idx lim : Num) (d top fl s : W32) (xs ps : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])

  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (before : Heap) (fp : GProp)

if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
```
