       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_page_allocate_post(
        d,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,

    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      vs == NIL
      && lc == APPEND(
           args,
           [V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
            V_num(ConstInt32(0w)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
            V_num(ConstInt32(0w))])
      && tlsf_page_allocate_pre(

    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>

definition `tlsf_page_allocate_spec`

```
tlsf_page_allocate_spec(
  (inst : Inst),
  (d : W32),
  (take_idx : Num),
  (page_idx : Num),
  (a : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  a == sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx)
  && (
       ∃ lim : Num,
         ∃ top : W32,
           ∃ xs : List[W32],
             ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl : W32,
                 ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     ∃ ps : List[W32],
                       ∃ sz : (W32) -> Num,
                         ∃ loc : (W32) -> List[W32],
                           ∃ cached : (W32) -> List[W32],
                             ∃ live : (W32) -> List[W32],
                               ∃ fast : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                 ∃ partial : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                   ∃ s : W32,
                                     ∃ before : Heap,
                                       ∃ fp : GProp,
                                         P == tlsf_page_allocate_pre(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top,
                                           xs,
                                           hd,
                                           fl,
                                           sb,
                                           bl,
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           fast,
                                           partial,
                                           s,
                                           before,
                                           fp)
                                         && Q == tlsf_page_allocate_post(
                                              d,
                                              lim,
                                              top,
                                              xs,
                                              hd,
                                              fl,
                                              sb,
                                              bl,
                                              ps,
                                              sz,
                                              loc,
                                              cached,
                                              live,
                                              fast,
                                              partial,

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_specs`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32)
  (pop push take_idx page_idx k : Num)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  specs_ok(
    k,
    tlsf_page_allocate_spec(inst, d, take_idx, page_idx),
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_all`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d top fl s : W32)
  (pop push take_idx page_idx lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp) (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_page_allocate_pre(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             partial,
             s,
             before,
             fp,
             args,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    [Call(page_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_page_allocate_post(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             partial,
             s,
             before,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_allocate_slots_refine`

```
∀ (n s : Num) (p : W32),
  tlsf_istar(tlsf_page_allocate_slot(p, s), n) == (
    tlsf_istar(tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, NIL), n)
    * tlsf_small_links(REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n))))
```

```

          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 20w)), serialise_i32(b))
          * pts(val((p +₃₂ 16w)), serialise_i32((u −₃₂ 1w)))

          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))

lemma `tlsf_block_free_if_skipped`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp Q : SAssn)
  (lc : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e])
  (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. c == 0w
  2. ∀ ls2 : List[SAssn],
       sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, st(NIL, lc, R), bs2, Q, ls2)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st([V_num(ConstInt32(c))], lc, R),
    [If(Tbv(SOME(T_num(T_i32))), bs1, bs2)],
    Q,
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_block_free_if_taken`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp Q : SAssn)
  (lc : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e])
  (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. !(c == 0w)
  2. ∀ ls2 : List[SAssn],
       sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, st(NIL, lc, R), bs1, Q, ls2)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st([V_num(ConstInt32(c))], lc, R),
    [If(Tbv(SOME(T_num(T_i32))), bs1, bs2)],
    Q,
    labels)
```

definition `tlsf_small_put`

```
tlsf_small_put((ff : (W32) -> List[W32]), (p : W32), (vs : List[W32]))
  == ((q : W32) => if q == p { vs } else { ff(q) })
```

definition `tlsf_small_put_class`

```
tlsf_small_put_class((ff : (Num) -> List[W32]), (j : Num), (vs : List[W32]))
  == ((k : Num) => if k == j { vs } else { ff(k) })
```

definition `tlsf_small_remove`

```
tlsf_small_remove((p : W32), (xs : List[W32]))
  == FILTER((q : W32) => !(q == p), xs)
```

definition `tlsf_block_free_loc`

```
tlsf_block_free_loc((loc : (W32) -> List[W32]), (p : W32), (b : W32))
  == tlsf_small_put(loc, p, CONS(b, loc(p)))
```

definition `tlsf_block_free_live`

```
tlsf_block_free_live((live : (W32) -> List[W32]), (p : W32), (b : W32))
  == tlsf_small_put(live, p, tlsf_small_remove(b, live(p)))
```

definition `tlsf_block_free_partial`

```
tlsf_block_free_partial(
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (p : W32)) == (
  if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) {
    tlsf_small_put_class(
      partial,
      DIV(sz(p), 8),
      CONS(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))) } else {
    if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == 1 {
      tlsf_small_put_class(
        partial,
        DIV(sz(p), 8),
        tlsf_small_remove(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))) } else { partial } })
```

definition `tlsf_block_free_pages`

```
tlsf_block_free_pages(
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (p : W32)) == (
  if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
    == 1 { tlsf_small_remove(p, ps) } else { ps })
```

lemma `tlsf_small_remove_member`

```
∀ (p q : W32) (xs : List[W32]),
  MEM(q, tlsf_small_remove(p, xs)) == (MEM(q, xs) && !(q == p))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_remove_nil`

```
∀ (p : W32), tlsf_small_remove(p, NIL) == NIL
```

lemma `tlsf_small_remove_cons`

```
∀ (p h : W32) (t : List[W32]),
  tlsf_small_remove(p, CONS(h, t)) == (
    if h == p { tlsf_small_remove(p, t) } else {
      CONS(h, tlsf_small_remove(p, t)) })
```

lemma `tlsf_small_remove_absent`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. !MEM(p, xs)
then
  tlsf_small_remove(p, xs) == xs
```

lemma `tlsf_small_remove_split`

```
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. !MEM(p, a)
  2. !MEM(p, z)
then
  tlsf_small_remove(p, APPEND(a, CONS(p, z))) == APPEND(a, z)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_count_one_split`

```
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_count(p, APPEND(a, CONS(p, z))) == 1
then
  !MEM(p, a)
  && !MEM(p, z)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_release_partition`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached a z : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, APPEND(a, CONS(b, z)))
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, CONS(b, loc), cached, APPEND(a, z))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_release_used`

```
∀ (cached a z : List[W32]) (b : W32),
  tlsf_small_used(cached, APPEND(a, CONS(b, z)))
    == SUC(tlsf_small_used(cached, APPEND(a, z)))

if

then

&& tlsf_small_hlist(
     (ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool),
     CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]))) == (
     (ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool)((p : W32))

```

if

then

if

then

definition `tlsf_small_dlist`

```
tlsf_small_dlist((pr : W32), NIL, (nx : W32)) == emp
&& tlsf_small_dlist((pr : W32), CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])), (nx : W32)) == (
     pts(val((p : W32)) + 24, serialise_i32((pr : W32)))
     * pts(
         val((p : W32)) + 28,
         serialise_i32(
           if (ps : List[W32]) == NIL { (nx : W32) } else { HD(ps) }))
     * tlsf_small_dlist((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]), (nx : W32)))
```

tlsf_small_last((fallback : W32), (xs : List[W32]))

definition `tlsf_small_first`

```

```
tlsf_small_dtail((pr : W32), NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_dtail((pr : W32), CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]))) == (
     pts(val((p : W32)) + 24, serialise_i32((pr : W32)))
     * (
         if (ps : List[W32]) == NIL { emp } else {
           (
             pts(val((p : W32)) + 28, serialise_i32(HD((ps : List[W32]))))
             * tlsf_small_dtail((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]))) }))
```

  tlsf_small_dlist(pr, APPEND(a, z), nx) == (
    tlsf_small_dlist(pr, a, tlsf_small_first(z, nx))

lemma `tlsf_small_dlist_tail`

```

    * tlsf_small_dhead(xs, nx))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_dlist_unlink_view`

```
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (prev next p : W32),
  tlsf_small_dlist(prev, APPEND(a, CONS(p, z)), next) == (
    tlsf_small_dtail(prev, a)
    * (
        if a == NIL { emp } else {
          pts(val(tlsf_small_last(prev, a)) + 28, serialise_i32(p)) })
    * pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_last(prev, a)))
    * pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_first(z, next)))
    * (if z == NIL { emp } else { pts(val(HD(z)) + 24, serialise_i32(p)) })
    * tlsf_small_dhead(z, next)
    * emp)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_dlist_removed_view`

```
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (prev next : W32),
  tlsf_small_dlist(prev, APPEND(a, z), next) == (
    tlsf_small_dtail(prev, a)
    * (
        if a == NIL { emp } else {
          pts(
            val(tlsf_small_last(prev, a)) + 28,
            serialise_i32(tlsf_small_first(z, next))) })
    * (
        if z == NIL { emp } else {
          pts(val(HD(z)) + 24, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_last(prev, a))) })
    * tlsf_small_dhead(z, next)
    * emp)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_live_unique`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. MEM(b, live)
then
  MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s)))
  && tlsf_count(b, live) == 1
  && !MEM(b, loc)
  && !MEM(b, cached)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_release_model`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if

  2. MEM(b, live)
then

  && tlsf_small_used(cached, live)
       == SUC(tlsf_small_used(cached, tlsf_small_remove(b, live)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_class_bounds`

```
∀ (s : Num)
if
  1. 8 <= s
  2. s <= 256
  3. MOD(s, 8) == 0
then
  1 <= DIV(s, 8)
  && DIV(s, 8) < 33
  && s == 8 * DIV(s, 8)
  && DIV(s + 7, 8) == DIV(s, 8)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_class_word`

```
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 8 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 256
  3. MOD(val(s), 8) == 0
then
  (s +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w) == word(DIV(val(s), 8))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_word_eq`

```
∀ (m n : Num)
if
  1. m <= 66
  2. n <= 66
then
  ((word : (Num) -> W32)(m) == (word : (Num) -> W32)(n)) == (m == n)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_word_dec`

```
∀ (n : Num)
if
  1. 1 <= n
then
  (word(n) −₃₂ 1w) == word(n - 1)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_class_shift`

```
∀ (k : Num)
if
  1. k < 33
then
  (word(k) <<₃₂ 3w) == word(8 * k)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_table_address`

```
∀ (d : W32) (s : Num)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. 8 <= s
  3. s <= 256
  4. MOD(s, 8) == 0
then
  (word(s) +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w) == word(DIV(s, 8))
  && val((tlsf_base(d) +₃₂ ((word(s) +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w) <<₃₂ 3w) +₃₂ 1916w))
       == val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1916 + 8 * DIV(s, 8)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_usage_flag`

```
∀ (u total : Num)
if
  1. u <= 66
  2. total <= 66
then
  wasm_bool((word : (Num) -> W32)(u) == (word : (Num) -> W32)(total))
    == (if u == total { 1w } else { 0w })
```

lemma `tlsf_small_usage_one_flag`

```
∀ (u : Num)
if
  1. u <= 66
then
  wasm_bool(word(u) == 1w) == (if u == 1 { 1w } else { 0w })
```

lemma `tlsf_block_free_publish_nil_list`

```
∀ (d p nx : W32) (free_idx s : Num) (tail : List[W32]) (u l2 : Value)
  (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. 8 <= s
  3. s <= 256
  4. MOD(s, 8) == 0
  5. !(p == 0w)
  6. val(p) + 32 <= 4294967296
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(p) + 8, serialise_i32(word(s)))
          * tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8)
          * pts(
              val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1916 + 8 * DIV(s, 8),
              serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(NIL)))
          * tlsf_small_partial_links(0w, NIL)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_block_free_publish(d, free_idx),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(DIV(s, 8))))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(p) + 8, serialise_i32(word(s)))
          * pts(val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1916 + 8 * DIV(s, 8), serialise_i32(p))
          * tlsf_small_partial_links(0w, [p])
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

          * tlsf_small_partial_links(0w, APPEND(a, [p]))
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_block_free_unlink(d, free_idx),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_last(0w, a)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          pts(val(p) + 8, serialise_i32(word(s)))
          * pts(
              val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1916 + 8 * DIV(s, 8),
              serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(APPEND(a, NIL))))
          * tlsf_small_partial_links(0w, APPEND(a, NIL))
          * pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_last(0w, a)))
          * pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(0w))
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_page_release_ok`

```
∀ (lim cap s : Num) (p b : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. MEM(b, live)
then
  tlsf_small_page_ok(
    lim,
    p,
    cap,
    s,
    CONS(b, loc),
    cached,
    tlsf_small_remove(b, live))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_backing_release`

```
∀ (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (p b : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. MEM(b, live(p))
then
  tlsf_small_backing(
    xs,
    hd,
    ps,
    sz,
    tlsf_block_free_loc(loc, p, b),
    cached,
    tlsf_block_free_live(live, p, b),
    lim)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_page_member_geometry`

```
∀ (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num)
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
then
  tlsf_small_page_ok(
    lim,
    p,
    val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
    sz(p),
    loc(p),
    cached(p),
    live(p))
  && !(p == 0w)
  && val(p) + 32 <= 4294967296
  && 8 <= sz(p)
  && sz(p) <= 256
  && MOD(sz(p), 8) == 0
  && DIV(sz(p), 8) < 33
```

lemma `tlsf_small_partial_geometry`

```
∀ (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim j : Num)
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (q : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. j < 33
  4. MEM(q, partial(j))
then
  !(q == 0w)
  && val(q) + 32 <= 4294967296
```

lemma `tlsf_small_live_release_usage`

```
∀ (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num)
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (p b : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. MEM(b, live(p))
then
  1 <= tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
  && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) <= tlsf_small_total(sz(p))
  && tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) <= 66
  && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
       == SUC(tlsf_small_used(cached(p), tlsf_small_remove(b, live(p))))
  && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == 1 → cached(p) == NIL
     && tlsf_small_remove(b, live(p)) == NIL
```

  3. 1 < tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))

    ps,
    sz,
    tlsf_block_free_loc(loc, p, b),

```

lemma `tlsf_small_partial_remove_class`

```
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])

lemma `tlsf_small_lists_partial_ext`

```
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast part1 part2 : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. ∀ p : W32, MEM(p, ps) → DIV(sz(p), 8) < 33
  2. ∀ j : Num, j < 33 → part1(j) == part2(j)
then
  tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, part1)
    == tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, part2)
```

```

lemma `tlsf_small_release_slots_frame`

```
∀ (n s i : Num) (p b : W32) (live : List[W32])
if
  1. ∀ j : Num, j < n && !(j == i) → !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j) == b)
then
  tlsf_istar(
    (j : Num) =>
      if j == i { emp } else {
        tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, tlsf_small_remove(b, live), j) },
    n) == tlsf_istar(
    (j : Num) => if j == i { emp } else { tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live, j) },
    n)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_release_slots_focus`

```
∀ (n s i : Num) (p b : W32) (live : List[W32])
if
  1. i < n
  2. ∀ j : Num, j < n && !(j == i) → !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j) == b)
then
  tlsf_istar(tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, tlsf_small_remove(b, live)), n) == (
    tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, tlsf_small_remove(b, live), i)
    * tlsf_istar(
        (j : Num) =>
          if j == i { emp } else { tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live, j) },
        n))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_count_empty`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32])
if
  1. ∀ q : W32, tlsf_count(q, xs) == 0
then
  xs == NIL
```

lemma `tlsf_small_hlist_permutation`

```
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool)
if
  1. ∀ q : W32, tlsf_count(q, xs) == tlsf_count(q, ys)
  2. ∀ q : W32, MEM(q, xs) → tlsf_count(q, xs) == 1
then
  tlsf_small_hlist(ff, xs) == tlsf_small_hlist(ff, ys)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_count_nil`

```
∀ (b : W32), tlsf_count(b, NIL) == 0
```

lemma `tlsf_small_slots_counts`

```
∀ (n s : Num) (p b : W32)
if
  1. ∀ i : Num,
       ∀ j : Num,
         i < n
         && j < n
         && tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i) == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j) → i == j
then
  tlsf_count(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n))
    == (if MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n)) { 1 } else { 0 })
```

lemma `tlsf_small_links_bytes`

```
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_small_links(xs, h)
then
  tlsf_small_hlist((b : W32) => tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 8, 4), xs, h)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_hlist_slots`

```
∀ (n s : Num) (ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool) (p : W32),
  tlsf_small_hlist(ff, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n))
    == tlsf_istar((i : Num) => ff(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)), n)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_reclaim_list`

```
∀ (lim cap s : Num) (p : W32) (loc : List[W32]) (ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, NIL, NIL)
then
  tlsf_small_hlist(ff, loc) == tlsf_istar(
    (i : Num) => ff(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)),
    tlsf_small_total(s))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_istar_pair`

```
∀ (n : Num) (ff gg : (Num, Heap) -> Bool),
  (tlsf_istar(ff, n) * tlsf_istar(gg, n))
    == tlsf_istar((i : Num) => (ff(i) * gg(i)), n)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_istar_mono`

```
∀ (n : Num) (ff gg : (Num, Heap) -> Bool) (h : Heap)
if
  1. ∀ i : Num, i < n → (∀ h : Heap, ff(i, h) → gg(i, h))
  2. tlsf_istar(ff, n, h)
then
  tlsf_istar(gg, n, h)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_bytes_zero`

```
∀ (a : Num), tlsf_bytes(a, 0) == emp
```

lemma `tlsf_small_bytes_array`

```
∀ (n a stride : Num),
  tlsf_istar((i : Num) => tlsf_bytes(a + stride * i, stride), n)
    == tlsf_bytes(a, stride * n)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_recover_slot`

```
∀ (p : W32) (s i : Num) (R : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. 8 <= s
  2. (
       tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, NIL, i)
       * tlsf_bytes(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 8, 4)
       * R)(h)
then
  (tlsf_bytes(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)), 8 + s) * R)(h)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_words6`

```
∀ (a len : Num)
if
  1. 24 <= len
then
  tlsf_bytes(a, len) == (
    (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ w0 : W32,
        ∃ w1 : W32,
          ∃ w2 : W32,
            ∃ w3 : W32,
              ∃ w4 : W32,
                ∃ w5 : W32,
                  (
                    (
                      pts(a + 0, serialise_i32(w0))
                      * pts(a + 4, serialise_i32(w1))
                      * pts(a + 8, serialise_i32(w2))
                      * pts(a + 12, serialise_i32(w3))
                      * pts(a + 16, serialise_i32(w4))
                      * pts(a + 20, serialise_i32(w5))
                      * tlsf_bytes(a + 24, len - 24)
                      * emp)(h)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_recover_page`

```
∀ (lim cap s : Num) (p prev next : W32) (loc : List[W32]) (R : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, NIL, NIL)
  2. (
       tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, loc, NIL, NIL)
       * pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(prev))
       * pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(next))
       * R)(h)
then
  (tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 8, cap) * R)(h)
```

definition `tlsf_block_free_release_frame`

```
tlsf_block_free_release_frame(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32]),
  (b : W32),
  (i : Num)) == (
  pts(val((p : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(word((s : Num))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total((s : Num)))))
  * pts(val((b : W32)), serialise_i32(4w))
  * (
      if tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])) < tlsf_small_total(
        (s : Num)) { emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val((p : W32)) + 24, 8) })
  * tlsf_istar(
      (j : Num) =>
        if j == (i : Num) { emp } else {
          tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32]), j) },
      tlsf_small_total(s))
  * tlsf_small_links((loc : List[W32]))
  * tlsf_bytes(val((b : W32)) + 12, (s : Num) - 4)
  * tlsf_bytes(
      val((p : W32)) + 32 + (8 + (s : Num)) * tlsf_small_total(s),
      (cap : Num) - 24 - (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s))
  * emp)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_page_release_pre_view`

```
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p b : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  4. MEM(b, live)
then
  (
    tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
    * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 8, s)) == (
    (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ oldword : W32,
        (
          (
            pts(val(b) + 4, serialise_i32(p))
            * pts(val(b) + 8, serialise_i32(oldword))
            * pts(
                val(p) + 16,
                serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_used(cached, live))))
            * pts(val(p) + 20, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(loc)))
            * tlsf_block_free_release_frame(
                p,
                cap,
                s,
                loc,
                cached,
                live,
                b,
                i)
            * emp)(h)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_page_release_post_view`

```
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p b : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  4. MEM(b, live)
then
  (
    pts(val(b) + 4, serialise_i32(p))
    * pts(val(b) + 8, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(loc)))
    * pts(
        val(p) + 16,
        serialise_i32(
          word(tlsf_small_used(cached, tlsf_small_remove(b, live)))))
    * pts(val(p) + 20, serialise_i32(b))
    * tlsf_block_free_release_frame(p, cap, s, loc, cached, live, b, i)
    * emp) == (
    tlsf_small_page_heap(
      p,
      cap,
      s,
      CONS(b, loc),
      cached,
      tlsf_small_remove(b, live))
    * (
        if tlsf_small_used(cached, live) < tlsf_small_total(s) { emp } else {
          tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8) }))
```

lemma `tlsf_block_free_release_page`

```
∀ (d p b : W32) (free_idx lim cap s i : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
  (l0 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  4. MEM(b, live)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [l0, V_num(ConstInt32(b)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          (
            tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
            * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 8, s))
          * fp(gs, ms))),
    tlsf_block_free_release(d, free_idx),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(tlsf_small_used(cached, live)))), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          (
            tlsf_small_page_heap(
              p,
              cap,
              s,
              CONS(b, loc),
              cached,
              tlsf_small_remove(b, live))
            * (
                if tlsf_small_used(cached, live) < tlsf_small_total(s) {
                  emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8) }))
          * fp(gs, ms))))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_pages_hlist`

```
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live) == tlsf_small_hlist(
    (p : W32) =>
      tlsf_small_page_heap(
        p,
        val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
        sz(p),
        loc(p),
        cached(p),
        live(p)),
    ps)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_pages_focus`

```
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
then
  tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live) == (
    tlsf_small_page_heap(
      p,
      val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
      sz(p),
      loc(p),
      cached(p),
      live(p))
    * tlsf_small_pages_heap(
        tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
        hd,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_pages_release_rest`

```
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (p b : W32),
  tlsf_small_pages_heap(
    tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
    hd,
    sz,
    tlsf_block_free_loc(loc, p, b),
    cached,
    tlsf_block_free_live(live, p, b)) == tlsf_small_pages_heap(
    tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
    hd,
    sz,
    loc,
    cached,
    live)
```

lemma `tlsf_block_free_release_pages`

```
∀ (free_idx lim i : Num) (d top fl p b : W32) (xs ps : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (l0 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
  4. MEM(b, live(p))
  5. i < tlsf_small_total(sz(p))
  6. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, sz(p), i)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [l0, V_num(ConstInt32(b)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 8, sz(p))
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_block_free_release(d, free_idx),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))))), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(
            ps,
            hd,
            sz,
            tlsf_block_free_loc(loc, p, b),
            cached,
            tlsf_block_free_live(live, p, b))
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * (
              if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(
                sz(p)) { emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8) })
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

definition `tlsf_block_free_page_tail`

```
tlsf_block_free_page_tail(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  pts(val((p : W32)) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total((s : Num)))))
  * pts(
      val((p : W32)) + 16,
      serialise_i32(
        word(tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 20, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((loc : List[W32]))))
  * (
      if tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])) < tlsf_small_total(
        (s : Num)) { emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val((p : W32)) + 24, 8) })
  * tlsf_istar(
      tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32])),
      tlsf_small_total(s))
  * tlsf_small_links((loc : List[W32]))
  * tlsf_bytes(
      val((p : W32)) + 32 + (8 + (s : Num)) * tlsf_small_total(s),
      (cap : Num) - 24 - (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s))
  * emp)
```

definition `tlsf_block_free_page_without_total`

```
tlsf_block_free_page_without_total(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  pts(val((p : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(word((s : Num))))
  * pts(
      val((p : W32)) + 16,
      serialise_i32(
        word(tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])))))
  * pts(val((p : W32)) + 20, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head((loc : List[W32]))))
  * (
      if tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32])) < tlsf_small_total(
        (s : Num)) { emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val((p : W32)) + 24, 8) })
  * tlsf_istar(
      tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32])),
      tlsf_small_total(s))
  * tlsf_small_links((loc : List[W32]))
  * tlsf_bytes(
      val((p : W32)) + 32 + (8 + (s : Num)) * tlsf_small_total(s),
      (cap : Num) - 24 - (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s))
  * emp
  * emp)
```

lemma `tlsf_block_free_publish_pages`

```
∀ (free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p : W32) (xs ps : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (u l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
  4. val(d) <= 4294965088
  5. ∀ q : W32,
       MEM(q, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8))) → !(q == 0w) && val(q) + 32 <= 4294967296
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_block_free_publish(d, free_idx),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(partial(DIV(sz(p), 8))))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(DIV(sz(p), 8))))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
          * tlsf_small_table(
              d,
              fast,
              tlsf_small_put_class(
                partial,
                DIV(sz(p), 8),
                CONS(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))))
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_block_free_classify_pages`

```
∀ (free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p u : W32) (xs ps : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(u)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_block_free_classify(d, free_idx),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(wasm_bool(u == word(tlsf_small_total(sz(p))))))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(u)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_block_free_reclaim_head_nil_pages`

```
∀ (free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p nx : W32) (xs ps a tail : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (u l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
  4. cached(p) == NIL
  5. live(p) == NIL
  6. val(d) <= 4294965088
  7. partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)) == APPEND(NIL, [p])
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_block_free_unlink(d, free_idx),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(DIV(sz(p), 8))))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))))
          * tlsf_small_pages_heap(
              tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
              hd,
              sz,
              loc,
              cached,
              live)
          * tlsf_small_table(
              d,
              fast,
              tlsf_small_put_class(partial, DIV(sz(p), 8), APPEND(NIL, NIL)))
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_block_free_reclaim_head_cons_pages`

```
∀ (free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p nx : W32) (xs ps a tail : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (u l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
  4. cached(p) == NIL
  5. live(p) == NIL
  6. val(d) <= 4294965088
  7. partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)) == APPEND(NIL, CONS(p, CONS(nx, tail)))
  8. !(nx == 0w)
  9. val(nx) + 32 <= 4294967296
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_block_free_unlink(d, free_idx),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(nx)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(DIV(sz(p), 8))))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))))
          * tlsf_small_pages_heap(
              tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
              hd,
              sz,
              loc,
              cached,
              live)
          * tlsf_small_table(
              d,
              fast,
              tlsf_small_put_class(
                partial,
                DIV(sz(p), 8),
                APPEND(NIL, CONS(nx, tail))))
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_free_retained_pages`

```
∀ (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (m p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, xs)
       && !(x == m)
       && tlsf_used(hd(x)) → MEM(x, xs2)
       && hd2(x) == hd(x)
  4. MEM(p, ps)
then
  MEM(p, xs2)
  && hd2(p) == hd(p)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_free_backing`

```
∀ (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (m : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, xs)
       && !(x == m)
       && tlsf_used(hd(x)) → MEM(x, xs2)
       && hd2(x) == hd(x)
then
  tlsf_small_backing(xs2, hd2, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_free_heap`

```
∀ (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (m d : W32)
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, xs)
       && !(x == m)
       && tlsf_used(hd(x)) → MEM(x, xs2)
       && hd2(x) == hd(x)
then
  tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
    == tlsf_small(d, hd2, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
```

definition `tlsf_small_return_post`

```
tlsf_small_return_post(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))]
    && ms == lim
    && (
         ∃ top2 : W32,
           ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
             ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl2 : W32,
                 ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     (
                       (
                         tlsf_allocator(
                           (d : W32),
                           (lim : Num),
                           top2,
                           xs2,
                           hd2,
                           fl2,
                           sb2,
                           bl2,
                           (ps : List[W32]),
                           (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                           (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                           (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                           (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                           (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                           (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
                         * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h))))
```

lemma `tlsf_small_return_post_fold`

```
∀ (d top fl m : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp) (res gs : List[Value]) (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. tlsf_free_post(
       d,
       m,
       lim,
       top,
       xs,
       hd,
       fl,
       sb,
       bl,
       (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
         (
           tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
           * fp(gs, ms)),
       res,
       gs,
       ms,
       h)
then
  tlsf_small_return_post(
    d,
    lim,
    top,
    xs,
    hd,
    fl,
    sb,
    bl,
    ps,
    sz,
    loc,
    cached,
    live,
    fast,
    partial,
    m,
    fp,
    res,
    gs,
    ms,
    h)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_return_all`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (pop push free_idx lim : Num)
  (d top fl m : W32) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp) (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_free_pre(
             d,
             m,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
               (
                 tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
                 * fp(gs, ms)),
             args,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    [Call(free_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_small_return_post(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             partial,
             m,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)
```

```
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)

lemma `tlsf_block_free_reclaim_head_nil_all`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (pop push free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p nx : W32)
  (xs ps a tail : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (u l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
  4. cached(p) == NIL
  5. live(p) == NIL
  6. val(d) <= 4294965088
  7. partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)) == APPEND(NIL, [p])
  8. tlsf_small_lists_ok(
       tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
       sz,
       loc,
       cached,
       live,
       fast,
       tlsf_small_put_class(partial, DIV(sz(p), 8), APPEND(NIL, NIL)))
  9. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  10. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
        inst,
        Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
        [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
        tlsf_pop_code(d))
  11. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
        inst,
        Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
        [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
        tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
               * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp)(h))),
    tlsf_block_free_reclaim(d, free_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(NIL, res)
        && lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(0w)),
            V_num(ConstInt32(word(DIV(sz(p), 8))))]
        && tlsf_small_return_post(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             tlsf_small_put_class(partial, DIV(sz(p), 8), APPEND(NIL, NIL)),
             p,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    labels)
```

        && tlsf_small_return_post(

lemma `tlsf_block_free_reclaim_prev_cons_all`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (pop push free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p nx : W32)
  (xs ps a tail : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (u l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
  4. cached(p) == NIL
  5. live(p) == NIL
  6. val(d) <= 4294965088
  7. partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)) == APPEND(a, CONS(p, CONS(nx, tail)))
  8. tlsf_small_lists_ok(
       tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
       sz,
       loc,
       cached,
       live,
       fast,
       tlsf_small_put_class(partial, DIV(sz(p), 8), APPEND(a, CONS(nx, tail))))
  9. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  10. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
        inst,
        Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
        [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
        tlsf_pop_code(d))
  11. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
        inst,
        Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
        [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
        tlsf_push_code(d))
  12. !(a == NIL)
  13. !(tlsf_small_last(0w, a) == 0w)
  14. val(tlsf_small_last(0w, a)) + 32 <= 4294967296
  15. !(nx == 0w)
  16. val(nx) + 32 <= 4294967296
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
               * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp)(h))),
    tlsf_block_free_reclaim(d, free_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(NIL, res)
        && lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(nx)),
            V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_last(0w, a)))]
        && tlsf_small_return_post(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             tlsf_small_put_class(
               partial,
               DIV(sz(p), 8),
               APPEND(a, CONS(nx, tail))),
             p,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    labels)

tlsf_block_free_pre(
  (d : W32),

  (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
  (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    vs == NIL
    && lc == [l0, V_num(ConstInt32(b)), l2]
    && ms == lim
    && MEM(p, ps)
    && MEM(b, live(p))
    && (
         (
           tlsf_allocator(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),

             (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
             (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
           * tlsf_bytes(val((b : W32)) + 8, (sz : (W32) -> Num)((p : W32)))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))

tlsf_block_free_post(

         ∃ top2 : W32,
           ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
             ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl2 : W32,
                 ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     (
                       (
                         tlsf_allocator(
                           (d : W32),
                           (lim : Num),
                           top2,
                           xs2,
                           hd2,
                           fl2,

                             (ps : List[W32]),

                             (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                             (p : W32)),
                           (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                           tlsf_block_free_loc(
                             (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),

                           cached,

                           (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                           tlsf_block_free_partial(
                             (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                             sz,

lemma `tlsf_block_free_tail_full`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (pop push free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p b : W32)
  (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (l0 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
  4. MEM(b, live(p))
  5. val(d) <= 4294965088
  6. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  7. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  8. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  9. tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == tlsf_small_total(sz(p))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))))), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(
            ps,
            hd,
            sz,
            tlsf_block_free_loc(loc, p, b),
            cached,
            tlsf_block_free_live(live, p, b))
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * (
              if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(
                sz(p)) { emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8) })
          * (
              (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
                ms == lim
                && (
                     (
                       tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
                       * fp(gs, ms))(h)))(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_block_free_tail(d, free_idx),
    tlsf_block_free_post(
      d,
      lim,
      top,
      xs,
      hd,
      fl,
      sb,
      bl,
      ps,
      sz,
      loc,
      cached,
      live,
      fast,
      partial,
      p,
      b,
      l0,
      l2,
      fp),
    labels)
```

lemma `tlsf_small_live_slot`

```
∀ (d top fl p b : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. MEM(b, live(p))
then
  ∃ (i : Num),
    i < tlsf_small_total(sz(p))
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, sz(p), i)
```

## Compiled allocation-side page publication (tlsf_page_publish_*.mbt)

program `tlsf_page_publish_fresh_code`

```
tlsf_page_publish_fresh_code((d : W32)) ==
  local.get 1
  i32.const 8
  i32.add
  local.tee 1
  i32.load offset=0 align=2**2

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_slot_rest`

```
∀ (n s i : Num) (p b : W32) (live : List[W32])
if
  1. ∀ j : Num, j < n && !(j == i) → !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j) == b)
then
  tlsf_istar(
    (j : Num) =>
      if j == i { emp } else { tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, CONS(b, live), j) },
    n) == tlsf_istar(
    (j : Num) => if j == i { emp } else { tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live, j) },
    n)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_slots_pre`

```
∀ (n s i : Num) (p b : W32) (live : List[W32])
if
  1. i < n
  2. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  3. !MEM(b, live)
  4. ∀ j : Num, j < n && !(j == i) → !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j) == b)
then
  tlsf_istar(tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live), n) == (
    pts(val(b), serialise_i32(4w))
    * pts(val(b) + 4, serialise_i32(p))
    * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 12, s - 4)
    * tlsf_istar(
        (j : Num) =>
          if j == i { emp } else { tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live, j) },
        n)
    * emp)
```

definition `tlsf_page_publish_frame`

```
tlsf_page_publish_frame(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (live : List[W32]),
  (b : W32),
  (i : Num)) == (
  pts(val((p : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(word((s : Num))))
  * pts(val((b : W32)), serialise_i32(4w))
  * pts(val((b : W32)) + 4, serialise_i32((p : W32)))
  * tlsf_istar(
      (j : Num) =>
        if j == (i : Num) { emp } else {
          tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32]), j) },
      tlsf_small_total(s))
  * tlsf_bytes(
      val((p : W32)) + 32 + (8 + (s : Num)) * tlsf_small_total(s),
      (cap : Num) - 24 - (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s))
  * emp)
```

definition `tlsf_page_publish_payload`

```
tlsf_page_publish_payload((b : W32), (s : Num)) == (
  pts(val((b : W32)) + 8, serialise_i32(0w))
  * tlsf_bytes(val((b : W32)) + 12, (s : Num) - 4))
```

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_view_facts`

```
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p b : W32) (bs live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
then
  !MEM(b, live)
  && ∀ j : Num,
       j < tlsf_small_total(s) && !(j == i) → !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j) == b)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_page_pre`

```
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p b : W32) (bs live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
then
  tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, live) == (
    pts(val(b) + 8, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(bs)))
    * pts(val(p) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total(s))))
    * pts(val(p) + 16, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_used(NIL, live))))
    * pts(val(p) + 20, serialise_i32(b))
    * tlsf_page_publish_frame(p, cap, s, live, b, i)
    * tlsf_small_links(bs)
    * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 12, s - 4)
    * emp)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_page_post`

```
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p b : W32) (bs live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)

    tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, NIL, bs, CONS(b, live))
    * tlsf_small_links(bs)

    * pts(val(b) + 8, serialise_i32(0w))
    * pts(val(p) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total(s))))
    * pts(val(p) + 16, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total(s))))
    * pts(val(p) + 20, serialise_i32(0w))
    * tlsf_page_publish_frame(p, cap, s, live, b, i)
    * tlsf_small_links(bs)
    * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 12, s - 4)
    * emp)

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_lists`

```
∀ (ps ps2 bs : List[W32]) (sz sz2 : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live loc2 cached2 live2 : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial fast2 partial2 : (Num) -> List[W32]) (p : W32) (s k : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  2. ∀ q : W32, MEM(q, ps) → DIV(sz(q), 8) < 33
  3. ∀ q : W32,
       !(q == p) → MEM(q, ps2) == MEM(q, ps)
       && tlsf_count(q, ps2) == tlsf_count(q, ps)
       && sz2(q) == sz(q)
       && cached2(q) == cached(q)
       && live2(q) == live(q)
  4. MEM(p, ps2)
  5. tlsf_count(p, ps2) == 1
  6. sz2(p) == s
  7. cached2(p) == bs
  8. tlsf_small_used(cached2(p), live2(p)) == tlsf_small_total(s)
  9. 0 < tlsf_small_total(s)
  10. s == 8 * k
  11. k < 33
  12. !MEM(p, ps) || cached(p) == NIL
  13. fast(k) == NIL
  14. fast2 == tlsf_small_put_class(fast, k, bs)
  15. ∀ b : W32, MEM(b, bs) → tlsf_count(b, bs) == 1
  16. ∀ j : Num, j < 33 → partial2(j) == tlsf_small_remove(p, partial(j))
then
  tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps2, sz2, loc2, cached2, live2, fast2, partial2)
```

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_backing_classes`

```
∀ (d top fl q : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(q, ps)
then
  8 <= sz(q)
  && sz(q) <= 256
  && MOD(sz(q), 8) == 0
  && DIV(sz(q), 8) < 33
```

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_partial_models`

```
∀ (d top fl p b : W32) (lim s : Num) (xs ps bs z : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. fast(DIV(sz(p), 8)) == NIL
  4. MEM(p, ps)
  5. loc(p) == CONS(b, bs)
  6. cached(p) == NIL
  7. partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)) == CONS(p, z)
then
  tlsf_small_backing(
    xs,
    hd,
    ps,
    sz,
    tlsf_small_put(loc, p, NIL),
    tlsf_small_put(cached, p, bs),
    tlsf_small_put(live, p, CONS(b, live(p))),
    lim)
  && tlsf_small_lists_ok(
       ps,
       sz,
       tlsf_small_put(loc, p, NIL),
       tlsf_small_put(cached, p, bs),
       tlsf_small_put(live, p, CONS(b, live(p))),
       tlsf_small_put_class(fast, DIV(sz(p), 8), bs),
       tlsf_small_put_class(partial, DIV(sz(p), 8), TL(partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))))
```

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_fresh_models`

```
∀ (d top fl p b : W32) (lim s : Num) (xs ps bs z : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. fast(DIV(s, 8)) == NIL
  4. !MEM(p, ps)
  5. MEM(p, xs)
  6. tlsf_used(hd(p))
  7. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))), s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, NIL)
then
  tlsf_small_backing(
    xs,
    hd,
    CONS(p, ps),
    (q : W32) => if q == p { s } else { sz(q) },
    tlsf_small_put(loc, p, NIL),
    tlsf_small_put(cached, p, bs),
    tlsf_small_put(live, p, [b]),
    lim)
  && tlsf_small_lists_ok(
       CONS(p, ps),
       (q : W32) => if q == p { s } else { sz(q) },
       tlsf_small_put(loc, p, NIL),
       tlsf_small_put(cached, p, bs),
       tlsf_small_put(live, p, [b]),
       tlsf_small_put_class(fast, DIV(s, 8), bs),
       partial)
```

if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, s)
then
  tlsf_small_partition(

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_fresh_ready`

```
∀ (p : W32) (cap s lim : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, cap, s)
  2. val(p) + 8 + cap <= lim
  3. lim <= 4294967296
then
  tlsf_small_page_ok(
    lim,
    p,
    cap,
    s,

lemma `tlsf_page_publish_fresh_view`

```
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p b used0 prev0 : W32) (bs : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, NIL)

  3. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  4. REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  tlsf_page_allocate_build(p, cap, s, tlsf_small_total(s), used0, prev0) == (
    pts(val(p) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total(s))))
    * pts(val(p) + 16, serialise_i32(used0))
    * pts(val(p) + 20, serialise_i32(b))
    * pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(prev0))
    * pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(0w))
    * pts(val(b) + 8, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(bs)))
    * tlsf_page_publish_frame(p, cap, s, NIL, b, i)
    * tlsf_small_links(bs)
    * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 12, s - 4)
    * emp)
```

definition `tlsf_malloc_owned`

```
tlsf_malloc_owned(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ptr : W32),
  (cap : Num)) == (
  (
    ∃ m : W32,
      MEM(m, xs)
      && !MEM(m, ps)
      && tlsf_used(hd(m))
      && ptr == (m +₃₂ 8w)
      && cap == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
  || (
       ∃ p : W32,
         ∃ b : W32,
           MEM(p, ps) && MEM(b, live(p)) && ptr == (b +₃₂ 8w) && cap == sz(p)))
```

  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ∃ top : W32,
      ∃ xs : List[W32],
        ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
          ∃ fl : W32,

                        ∃ live : (W32) -> List[W32],
                          ∃ fast : (Num) -> List[W32],
                            ∃ partial : (Num) -> List[W32],
                              ∃ cap : Num,
                                !(ptr == 0w)
                                && !(ptr == 4294967295w)
                                && val(n) <= cap
                                && val(ptr) + cap <= ms
                                && oldlim <= ms

lemma `tlsf_malloc_small_round`

```
∀ (n : Num)
if
  1. 0 < n
  2. n <= 256
then
  1 <= DIV(n + 7, 8)
  && DIV(n + 7, 8) <= 32
  && n <= 8 * DIV(n + 7, 8)
  && 8 * DIV(n + 7, 8) <= 256
  && MOD(8 * DIV(n + 7, 8), 8) == 0
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_small_class_word`

```
∀ (n : W32)
if
  1. 0 < val(n)
  2. val(n) <= 256
then
  (n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w) == word(DIV(val(n) + 7, 8))
  && ((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w) <<₃₂ 3w) == word(8 * DIV(val(n) + 7, 8))
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_cached_partition`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. MEM(b, cached)
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, tlsf_small_remove(b, cached), CONS(b, live))
  && tlsf_small_used(tlsf_small_remove(b, cached), CONS(b, live))
       == tlsf_small_used(cached, live)
  && !MEM(b, live)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_cache_page_view`

```
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p b : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. MEM(b, cached)
  3. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  4. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
then
  tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, loc, cached, live) == (
    tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 12, s - 4)
    * tlsf_small_page_heap(
        p,
        cap,
        s,
        loc,
        tlsf_small_remove(b, cached),
        CONS(b, live)))
```

```
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])

  2. MEM(b, cached)
then
  MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s)))
  && tlsf_count(b, cached) == 1
  && !MEM(b, live)
  && !MEM(b, loc)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_cached_slot`

```
∀ (d top fl p b : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. MEM(b, cached(p))
then
  ∃ (i : Num),
    i < tlsf_small_total(sz(p))
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, sz(p), i)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_cached_bounds`

```
∀ (d top fl p b : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. MEM(b, cached(p))
then
  val(p) + 32 <= val(b)
  && val(b) + 8 + sz(p) <= val(p) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(p)))
  && !(b == 0w)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_cached_other`

```
∀ (d top fl p q b : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
  4. MEM(b, cached(p))

then

```

```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_cached_lists`

```
∀ (d top fl p b : W32) (lim k : Num) (xs ps bs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. MEM(b, cached(p))
  4. sz(p) == 8 * k
  5. k < 33
  6. fast(k) == CONS(b, bs)
  7. ∀ q : W32,
       tlsf_small_used(
         tlsf_small_put(cached, p, tlsf_small_remove(b, cached(p)), q),
         tlsf_small_put(live, p, CONS(b, live(p)), q))
         == tlsf_small_used(cached(q), live(q))
  8. ∀ q : W32, MEM(q, ps) && !(q == p) → !MEM(b, cached(q))
then
  tlsf_small_lists_ok(
    ps,
    sz,
    loc,
    tlsf_small_put(cached, p, tlsf_small_remove(b, cached(p))),
    tlsf_small_put(live, p, CONS(b, live(p))),
    tlsf_small_put_class(fast, k, bs),
    partial)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_cached_models`

```
∀ (d top fl p b : W32) (lim k : Num) (xs ps bs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)

  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  4. MEM(p, ps)
  5. MEM(b, cached(p))
  6. sz(p) == 8 * k
  7. k < 33
  8. fast(k) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  tlsf_small_backing(
    xs,
    hd,
    ps,
    sz,
    loc,
    tlsf_small_put(cached, p, tlsf_small_remove(b, cached(p))),
    tlsf_small_put(live, p, CONS(b, live(p))),
    lim)
  && tlsf_small_lists_ok(
       ps,
       sz,
       loc,
       tlsf_small_put(cached, p, tlsf_small_remove(b, cached(p))),
       tlsf_small_put(live, p, CONS(b, live(p))),

       partial)
```

```
∀ (initialize_idx page_idx take_idx ensure_idx lim k i : Num)

  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)

  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. tlsf_small_page_ok(
       lim,
       p,
       val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
       8 * k,
       loc(p),
       cached(p),
       live(p))
  3. MEM(b, cached(p))
  4. i < tlsf_small_total(8 * k)
  5. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * k, i)
  6. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
  7. sz(p) == 8 * k
  8. k < 33
  9. fast(k) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(b)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(k))), l2, l3, l4],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live)
          * tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial)
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_malloc_try_cached(d, initialize_idx, page_idx, take_idx, ensure_idx),
    (res : List[Value]) => (lc2 : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc2 == [V_num(ConstInt32((b +₃₂ 8w))), V_num(ConstInt32(word(k))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(bs))), l3, l4]
      && res == [V_num(ConstInt32((b +₃₂ 8w)))]
      && (
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
             (
               tlsf_small_pages_heap(
                 ps,
                 hd,
                 sz,
                 loc,
                 tlsf_small_put(cached, p, tlsf_small_remove(b, cached(p))),
                 tlsf_small_put(live, p, CONS(b, live(p))))
               * tlsf_small_table(
                   d,
                   tlsf_small_put_class(fast, k, bs),
                   partial)
               * tlsf_page_publish_payload(b, 8 * k)
               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp))(gs, ms, h))

lemma `tlsf_malloc_first_publish_fresh_page`

```
∀ (initialize_idx page_idx take_idx ensure_idx lim cap s i : Num)
  (original l1 l3 l4 : Value) (d p b used0 prev0 : W32) (bs live : List[W32])
  (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, live)
  3. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  4. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  5. live == NIL
  6. REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [original, V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(b)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))), V_num(ConstInt32((p +₃₂ 20w))), l4],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          tlsf_page_allocate_build(
            p,
            cap,
            s,
            tlsf_small_total(s),
            used0,
            prev0)
          * pts(val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912 + s, serialise_i32(0w))
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)),
    tlsf_malloc_first_fresh(d, initialize_idx, page_idx, take_idx, ensure_idx),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32((b +₃₂ 8w)))],
      [original, V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32((b +₃₂ 8w))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))), V_num(ConstInt32((p +₃₂ 20w))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(bs)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        (
          (
            tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, NIL, bs, CONS(b, live))
            * tlsf_small_links(bs)
            * tlsf_page_publish_payload(b, s))
          * pts(
              val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912 + s,
              serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(bs)))
          * fp(gs, ms)
          * emp)))
```

```
∀ (initialize_idx page_idx take_idx ensure_idx lim k s i : Num)
  (original l1 l2 l3 l4 : Value) (d top fl p b used0 prev0 : W32)
  (xs ps bs z : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
     && tlsf_small_page_ok(
          lim,
          p,
          val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
          8 * k,
          loc(p),
          cached(p),
          live(p))
     && MEM(b, cached(p))
     && i < tlsf_small_total(8 * k)
     && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * k, i)
     && tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
     && sz(p) == 8 * k
     && k < 33
     && fast(k) == CONS(b, bs)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  4. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  5. MEM(p, ps)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(b)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(k))), l2, l3, l4],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_allocator(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 xs,
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl,
                 ps,
                 sz,
                 loc,
                 cached,

  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
     && tlsf_small_page_ok(
          lim,
          p,
          val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
          s,
          CONS(b, bs),
          NIL,
          NIL)
     && i < tlsf_small_total(s)
     && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
     && fast(DIV(s, 8)) == NIL
     && !MEM(p, ps)
     && REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  4. MEM(p, xs)
  5. tlsf_used(hd(p))
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(b)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))),
       V_num(ConstInt32((p +₃₂ 20w))), l4, original],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_page_allocate_build(
                 p,
                 val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
                 s,
                 tlsf_small_total(s),
                 used0,
                 prev0)
               * tlsf_allocator(
                   d,
                   lim,
                   top,
                   xs,
                   hd,
                   fl,
                   sb,
                   bl,
                   ps,
                   sz,
                   loc,
                   cached,
                   live,
                   fast,
                   partial)
               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp)(h))),
    tlsf_malloc_retry_fresh(d, initialize_idx, page_idx, take_idx, ensure_idx),
    (res : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32((b +₃₂ 8w))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))), V_num(ConstInt32((p +₃₂ 20w))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(bs))), original]
      && res == [V_num(ConstInt32((b +₃₂ 8w)))]
      && ms == lim
      && (
           (
             tlsf_page_publish_payload(b, s)
             * tlsf_allocator(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 xs,
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl,
                 CONS(p, ps),
                 (q : W32) => if q == p { s } else { sz(q) },
                 tlsf_small_put(loc, p, NIL),
                 tlsf_small_put(cached, p, bs),
                 tlsf_small_put(live, p, [b]),
                 tlsf_small_put_class(fast, DIV(s, 8), bs),
                 partial)
             * fp(gs, ms)
             * emp)(h)))
```

  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (client : HProp) (h : Heap)
if

       tlsf_allocator(

         hd,
         fl,
         sb,
         bl,
         ps,
         sz,
         loc,
         cached,
         live,
         fast,

       * client)(h)
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  && tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  && tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)

definition `tlsf_malloc_ro`

```
tlsf_malloc_ro(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && h == before
    && (
         (
           tlsf_allocator(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
             (ps : List[W32]),
             (sz : (W32) -> Num),
             (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
             (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
             (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, (lim : Num)))(h)))
```
