lemma `tlsf_malloc_request_setup`

```
∀ (n : W32)
if
  1. 0 < val(n)
  2. val(n) <= 256
then
  val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)) == DIV(val(n) + 7, 8)
  && val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)) < 33
  && 8 <= 8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
  && 8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)) <= 256
  && val(n) <= 8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
  && MOD(8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)), 8) == 0
  && ((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w) <<₃₂ 3w) == word(8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)))
  && (val : (W32) -> Num)(
       (word : (Num) -> W32)(8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))))
       == 8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
  && DIV(8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)), 8) == val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_cached_dispatch`

```
∀ (d top fl b : W32) (lim k : Num) (xs ps bs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. k < 33
  4. fast(k) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  ∃ (p : W32) (i : Num),
    tlsf_small_page_ok(
      lim,
      p,
      val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
      8 * k,
      loc(p),
      cached(p),
      live(p))
    && MEM(p, ps)
    && MEM(b, cached(p))
    && sz(p) == 8 * k
    && tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
    && i < tlsf_small_total(8 * k)
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * k, i)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_partial_dispatch`

```
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim k : Num) (xs ps z : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. k < 33
  4. fast(k) == NIL
  5. partial(k) == CONS(p, z)
then
  ∃ (b : W32) (bs : List[W32]) (i : Num),
    tlsf_small_page_ok(
      lim,
      p,
      val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
      8 * k,
      CONS(b, bs),
      NIL,
      live(p))
    && MEM(p, ps)
    && sz(p) == 8 * k
    && loc(p) == CONS(b, bs)
    && cached(p) == NIL
    && tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
    && i < tlsf_small_total(8 * k)
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * k, i)
    && ∀ q : W32, MEM(q, z) → !(q == 0w) && val(q) + 32 <= 4294967296
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_fresh_dispatch`

```
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim s : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(p, xs)
  3. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))), s)
then
  ∃ (b : W32) (bs : List[W32]) (i : Num),
    REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
    && tlsf_small_page_ok(
         lim,
         p,
         val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
         s,
         CONS(b, bs),
         NIL,
         NIL)
    && i < tlsf_small_total(s)
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
    && !(b == 0w)
```

```
tlsf_malloc_page_pre(
  (d : W32),

  (top : W32),

  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),

  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(s))]
    && 8 <= val(s)
    && val(s) <= 256
    && MOD(val(s), 8) == 0
    && ms == lim
    && h == before
    && (
         (
           tlsf_allocator(
             (d : W32),
             (lim : Num),
             (top : W32),
             (xs : List[W32]),
             (hd : (W32) -> W32),
             (fl : W32),
             (sb : (Num) -> W32),
             (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),

             (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),

             (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
           * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))
```

definition `tlsf_malloc_page_reserved`

```
tlsf_malloc_page_reserved(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),

  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (s : W32),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && (
         tlsf_search(1080w, fl, sb, bl) == 0w
         && res == [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))]
         && h == before
         && (
              (
                tlsf_allocator(
                  (d : W32),
                  (lim : Num),
                  (top : W32),
                  (xs : List[W32]),
                  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
                  (fl : W32),
                  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
                  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
                  (ps : List[W32]),
                  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
                * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h))
         || (
              ∃ p : W32,
                ∃ top2 : W32,
                  ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
                    ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
                      ∃ fl2 : W32,
                        ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                          ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                            res == [V_num(ConstInt32(p))]
                            && !(tlsf_search(1080w, fl, sb, bl) == 0w)
                            && !(p == 0w)
                            && !MEM(p, ps)
                            && MEM(p, xs2)
                            && tlsf_used(hd2(p))
                            && tlsf_retains(xs, hd, xs2, hd2)
                            && tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(
                                 p,
                                 val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                 val(s))
                            && (
                                 (
                                   tlsf_bytes(
                                     val(p) + 8,
                                     val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))))
                                   * tlsf_allocator(
                                       (d : W32),
                                       (lim : Num),
                                       top2,
                                       xs2,
                                       hd2,
                                       fl2,
                                       sb2,
                                       bl2,
                                       (ps : List[W32]),
                                       (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                                       (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                                       (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                                       (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
                                   * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h)))))
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_page_take_post`

```
∀ (d top fl s : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before h : Heap) (fp : GProp) (res gs : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. 8 <= val(s)
  3. val(s) <= 256
  4. MOD(val(s), 8) == 0
  5. tlsf_take_post(
       d,
       1080w,
       lim,
       top,
       xs,
       hd,
       fl,
       sb,
       bl,
       before,
       (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
         (
           tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
           * fp(gs, ms)),
       res,
       gs,
       ms,
       h)
then
  tlsf_malloc_page_reserved(
    d,
    lim,
    top,
    xs,
    hd,
    fl,
    sb,
    bl,
    ps,
    sz,
    loc,
    cached,
    live,
    fast,
    partial,
    s,
    before,
    fp,
    res,
    gs,
    ms,
    h)
```

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (take_idx lim : Num)

  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])

      tlsf_malloc_page_post(
        d,

lemma `tlsf_malloc_page_prefix`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (pop push take_idx lim : Num)
  (d top fl s : W32) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp) (l1 l2 l3 l4 l5 : Value)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. 8 <= val(s)
  3. val(s) <= 256
  4. MOD(val(s), 8) == 0
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  6. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  7. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), l1, l2, l3, l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && h == before
        && (
             (
               tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl)
               * tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
               * fp(gs, ms))(h))),
    tlsf_page_allocate_call(take_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), l1, l2, l3, l4, l5]

           xs,

           sb,

           ps,

           loc,

           live,
           fast,
           partial,
           s,
           before,
           fp,
           vs,
           gs,
           ms,
           h),
    NIL)

definition `tlsf_malloc_page_spec`

```
tlsf_malloc_page_spec(
  (inst : Inst),
  (d : W32),
  (take_idx : Num),
  (page_idx : Num),
  (a : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  a == sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx)
  && (
       ∃ lim : Num,
         ∃ top : W32,
           ∃ xs : List[W32],
             ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl : W32,
                 ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     ∃ ps : List[W32],
                       ∃ sz : (W32) -> Num,
                         ∃ loc : (W32) -> List[W32],
                           ∃ cached : (W32) -> List[W32],
                             ∃ live : (W32) -> List[W32],
                               ∃ fast : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                 ∃ partial : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                   ∃ s : W32,
                                     ∃ before : Heap,
                                       ∃ fp : GProp,
                                         P == tlsf_malloc_page_pre(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top,
                                           xs,
                                           hd,
                                           fl,
                                           sb,
                                           bl,
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           fast,
                                           partial,
                                           s,
                                           before,
                                           fp)
                                         && Q == tlsf_malloc_page_post(
                                              d,
                                              lim,
                                              top,
                                              xs,
                                              hd,
                                              fl,
                                              sb,
                                              bl,
                                              ps,
                                              sz,
                                              loc,
                                              cached,
                                              live,
                                              fast,
                                              partial,
                                              s,
                                              before,
                                              fp)))

lemma `tlsf_malloc_page_specs`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32)
  (pop push take_idx page_idx k : Num)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  specs_ok(
    k,
    tlsf_malloc_page_spec(inst, d, take_idx, page_idx),
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_page_all`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d top fl s : W32)
  (pop push take_idx page_idx lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp) (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_malloc_page_pre(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             partial,

             ms,

    [Call(page_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_malloc_page_post(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             partial,
             s,
             before,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)
```

definition `tlsf_malloc_page_ready_post`

```
tlsf_malloc_page_ready_post(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (s : W32),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && (
         res == [V_num(ConstInt32(0w))]
         && tlsf_search(1080w, fl, sb, bl) == 0w
         && h == before
         && (
              (
                tlsf_allocator(
                  (d : W32),
                  (lim : Num),
                  (top : W32),
                  (xs : List[W32]),
                  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
                  (fl : W32),
                  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
                  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
                  (ps : List[W32]),
                  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
                  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
                  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))
                * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms))(h))
         || (
              ∃ p : W32,
                ∃ top2 : W32,
                  ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
                    ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
                      ∃ fl2 : W32,
                        ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                          ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                            ∃ used0 : W32,
                              ∃ prev0 : W32,
                                ∃ b : W32,
                                  ∃ bs : List[W32],
                                    ∃ i : Num,
                                      res == [V_num(ConstInt32(p))]
                                      && !(
                                           tlsf_search(1080w, fl, sb, bl)
                                             == 0w)
                                      && !(p == 0w)
                                      && !MEM(p, ps)
                                      && MEM(p, xs2)
                                      && tlsf_used(hd2(p))
                                      && tlsf_physical_ok(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top2,
                                           xs2,
                                           hd2)
                                      && tlsf_small_backing(
                                           xs2,
                                           hd2,
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           lim)
                                      && tlsf_small_lists_ok(
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           fast,
                                           partial)
                                      && tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(
                                           p,
                                           val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                           val(s))
                                      && REVERSE(
                                           tlsf_small_slots(
                                             p,
                                             val(s),
                                             tlsf_small_total(val(s))))
                                           == CONS(b, bs)
                                      && tlsf_small_page_ok(
                                           lim,
                                           p,
                                           val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                           val(s),
                                           CONS(b, bs),
                                           NIL,
                                           NIL)
                                      && i < tlsf_small_total(val(s))
                                      && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, val(s), i)
                                      && !(b == 0w)
                                      && (
                                           (
                                             tlsf_page_allocate_build(
                                               p,
                                               val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                               val((s : W32)),
                                               tlsf_small_total(val(s)),
                                               used0,
                                               prev0)
                                             * tlsf_allocator(
                                                 (d : W32),
                                                 (lim : Num),
                                                 top2,
                                                 xs2,
                                                 hd2,
                                                 fl2,
                                                 sb2,
                                                 bl2,
                                                 (ps : List[W32]),
                                                 (sz : (W32) -> Num),
                                                 (
                                                   loc : (W32) -> List[
                                                     W32]),
                                                 (
                                                   cached : (W32) -> List[
                                                     W32]),
                                                 (
                                                   live : (W32) -> List[
                                                     W32]),
                                                 (
                                                   fast : (Num) -> List[
                                                     W32]),
                                                 (
                                                   partial : (Num) -> List[
                                                     W32]))
                                             * (fp : GProp)(gs, ms)
                                             * emp)(h)))))
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_page_expand`

```
∀ (d top fl s : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before h : Heap) (fp : GProp) (res gs : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_malloc_page_post(

lemma `tlsf_malloc_payload_frame`

```
∀ (b : W32) (sz : Num) (frame : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. 4 <= sz
  2. (tlsf_page_publish_payload(b, sz) * frame)(h)
then
  (tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 8, sz) * frame)(h)

lemma `tlsf_malloc_small_result`

```
∀ (d top fl p b n : W32) (lim oldlim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp) (gs : List[Value]) (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
  4. MEM(b, live(p))
  5. oldlim <= lim
  6. val(n) <= sz(p)
  7. (
       tlsf_page_publish_payload(b, sz(p))
       * tlsf_allocator(
           d,
           lim,
           top,
           xs,
           hd,
           fl,
           sb,
           bl,
           ps,
           sz,
           loc,
           cached,
           live,
           fast,
           partial)
       * fp(gs, oldlim))(h)
then
  tlsf_malloc_result(d, n, oldlim, fp, (b +₃₂ 8w), gs, lim, h)

lemma `tlsf_malloc_large_result`

```
∀ (d top fl m n : W32) (lim oldlim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])

  3. !MEM(m, ps)

           fl,

       * fp(gs, oldlim))(h)
then
  tlsf_malloc_result(d, n, oldlim, fp, (m +₃₂ 8w), gs, lim, h)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_try_available`

```
∀ (d top fl n : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before h : Heap) (fp : GProp) (res gs : List[Value])
if
  1. n == 0w
     || val(n) <= 256
        && (
             !(fast(DIV(val(n) + 7, 8)) == NIL)
             || !(partial(DIV(val(n) + 7, 8)) == NIL)
             || !(tlsf_search(1080w, fl, sb, bl) == 0w))
     || 256 < val(n) && !(tlsf_search(n, fl, sb, bl) == 0w)
  2. tlsf_try_malloc_post(
       d,
       lim,
       top,
       xs,
       hd,
       fl,
       sb,
       bl,
       ps,
       sz,
       loc,
       cached,
       live,
       fast,
       partial,
       n,
       before,
       fp,
       res,
       gs,
       ms,
       h)
then
  ∃ (ptr : W32),
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(ptr))]
    && !(ptr == 4294967295w)
    && tlsf_full_malloc_post(
         d,
         lim,
         top,
         xs,
         hd,
         fl,
         sb,
         bl,
         ps,
         sz,
         loc,
         cached,
         live,
         fast,
         partial,
         n,
         before,
         fp,
         res,
         gs,
         ms,
         h)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_try_cached_export`

```
∀ (initialize_idx page_idx take_idx ensure_idx lim k s i : Num)
  (original l1 l2 l3 l4 : Value) (d top fl p b used0 prev0 nreq : W32)
  (xs ps bs z : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp) (before : Heap)
if
  1. (
       val(d) <= 4294965088
       && tlsf_small_page_ok(
            lim,
            p,
            val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
            8 * k,
            loc(p),
            cached(p),
            live(p))
       && MEM(b, cached(p))
       && i < tlsf_small_total(8 * k)
       && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * k, i)
       && tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
       && sz(p) == 8 * k
       && k < 33
       && fast(k) == CONS(b, bs))
     && tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
     && tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
     && tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
     && MEM(p, ps)
  2. val(nreq) <= 8 * k
  3. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(b)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(k))), l2, l3, l4],
      tlsf_malloc_ro(
        d,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        ps,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live,
        fast,
        partial,
        before,
        fp)),
    tlsf_malloc_try_cached(d, initialize_idx, page_idx, take_idx, ensure_idx),
    (res : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc == [V_num(ConstInt32((b +₃₂ 8w))), V_num(ConstInt32(word(k))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(bs))), l3, l4]
      && res == [V_num(ConstInt32((b +₃₂ 8w)))]
      && ms == lim
      && tlsf_malloc_result(d, nreq, lim, fp, (b +₃₂ 8w), gs, ms, h))
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_take_call`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (pop push take_idx lim : Num)

  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp) (caller : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. 16 <= val(n)
  3. val(n) <= 4160749568
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],

  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(n))],
      caller,
      tlsf_malloc_ro(
        d,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        ps,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live,
        fast,
        partial,
        before,
        fp)),
    [Call(take_idx)],
    (res : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc == caller
      && tlsf_malloc_take_selected_post(
           d,
           lim,
           top,
           xs,
           hd,
           fl,
           sb,
           bl,
           ps,
           sz,
           loc,
           cached,
           live,
           fast,
           partial,
           n,
           before,
           fp,

           h),
    NIL)

                                             8 * val(kw),
                                             CONS(b, bs),
                                             NIL,
                                             NIL)
                                        && i < tlsf_small_total(8 * val(kw))
                                        && tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * val(kw), i)
                                             == b
                                        && !(b == 0w)
                                        && (
                                             (
                                               tlsf_page_allocate_build(
                                                 p,
                                                 val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                                 8 * val(kw),
                                                 tlsf_small_total(
                                                   8 * val(kw)),
                                                 used0,
                                                 prev0)
                                               * tlsf_allocator(
                                                   d,
                                                   lim,
                                                   top2,
                                                   xs2,
                                                   hd2,
                                                   fl2,
                                                   sb2,
                                                   bl2,
                                                   ps,
                                                   sz,
                                                   loc,
                                                   cached,
                                                   live,
                                                   fast,
                                                   partial)
                                               * fp(gs, ms)
                                               * emp)(h)))),
    labels)
```

lemma `st_malloc_fresh_head`

```
∀ (d top fl p b used0 prev0 : W32) (lim s i : Num) (xs ps bs : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp) (v lc : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))), s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, NIL)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  4. REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32((p +₃₂ 20w)))]),
      lc,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_page_allocate_build(
                 p,
                 val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
                 s,
                 tlsf_small_total(s),
                 used0,
                 prev0)
               * tlsf_allocator(
                   d,
                   lim,
                   top,
                   xs,
                   hd,
                   fl,
                   sb,
                   bl,
                   ps,
                   sz,
                   loc,
                   cached,
                   live,
                   fast,
                   partial)
               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp)(h))),
    [Load(T_i32, NONE, 2, 0)],
    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(b))]),
      lc,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_page_allocate_build(
                 p,
                 val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
                 s,
                 tlsf_small_total(s),
                 used0,
                 prev0)
               * tlsf_allocator(
                   d,
                   lim,
                   top,
                   xs,
                   hd,
                   fl,
                   sb,
                   bl,
                   ps,
                   sz,
                   loc,
                   cached,
                   live,
                   fast,
                   partial)
               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp)(h))))

lemma `tlsf_malloc_try_cached_case`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn])
  (initialize_idx page_idx take_idx ensure_idx pop push lim i : Num)
  (original l0 l1 l2 l3 l4 : Value) (d top fl n p b : W32)
  (xs ps bs z : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  4. !word_ugt(d, 4294965088w)
     && !word_uge(
          ((d +₃₂ 15w &₃₂ 4294967280w) +₃₂ 1908w >>>₃₂ 16w),
          word(DIV(lim, 65536)))
     && !(top == 0w)
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32),
           T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_pop_code(d))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_push_code(d))
  6. 0 < val(n)
  7. val(n) <= 256
  8. !(n == 0w)
  9. (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
       == DIV((val : (W32) -> Num)(n) + 7, 8)
     && (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)) < 33
     && 8 <= 8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
     && 8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)) <= 256
     && (val : (W32) -> Num)(n) <= 8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
     && MOD(8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)), 8) == 0
     && ((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w) <<₃₂ 3w) == (word : (Num) -> W32)(
          8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)))
     && (val : (W32) -> Num)(
          (word : (Num) -> W32)(8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))))
          == 8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
     && DIV(8 * (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)), 8)
          == (val : (W32) -> Num)((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
  10. (
        (
          val(d) <= 4294965088
          && tlsf_small_page_ok(
               lim,
               p,
               val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
               8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)),
               loc(p),
               cached(p),
               live(p))
          && MEM(b, cached(p))
          && i < tlsf_small_total(8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)))
          && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)), i)
          && tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
          && sz(p) == 8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
          && val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w)) < 33
          && fast(val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))) == CONS(b, bs))
        && tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
        && tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
        && tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
        && MEM(p, ps))
      && val(n) <= 8 * val((n +₃₂ 7w >>>₃₂ 3w))
      && tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  11. !(b == 0w)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_try_malloc_post(
        d,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        ps,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live,
        fast,
        partial,
        n,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l1, l2, l3, l4],
      tlsf_malloc_ro(
        d,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        ps,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live,
        fast,
        partial,
        before,
        fp)),
    tlsf_malloc_try_body(d, initialize_idx, page_idx, take_idx, ensure_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_try_malloc_post(
        d,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        ps,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live,
        fast,
        partial,
        n,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    [
      (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
      (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        tlsf_try_malloc_post(
          d,
          lim,
          top,
          xs,
          hd,
          fl,
          sb,
          bl,
          ps,
          sz,
          loc,
          cached,
          live,
          fast,
          partial,
          n,
          before,
          fp,
          vs,
          gs,
          ms,
          h)])
```

                                 ∃ partial : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                   ∃ n : W32,
                                     ∃ before : Heap,
                                       ∃ fp : GProp,
                                         P == tlsf_try_malloc_pre(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top,

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],

definition `tlsf_full_malloc_fast_spec`

```
tlsf_full_malloc_fast_spec(
  (inst : Inst),
  (d : W32),
  (initialize_idx : Num),
  (page_idx : Num),
  (take_idx : Num),
  (ensure_idx : Num),
  (full_idx : Num),
  (j : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  j == sfunc_ind(inst, full_idx)
  && (
       ∃ lim : Num,
         ∃ top : W32,
           ∃ xs : List[W32],
             ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl : W32,
                 ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     ∃ ps : List[W32],
                       ∃ sz : (W32) -> Num,
                         ∃ loc : (W32) -> List[W32],
                           ∃ cached : (W32) -> List[W32],
                             ∃ live : (W32) -> List[W32],
                               ∃ fast : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                 ∃ partial : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                   ∃ n : W32,
                                     ∃ before : Heap,
                                       ∃ fp : GProp,
                                         P == tlsf_full_malloc_fast_pre(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top,
                                           xs,
                                           hd,
                                           fl,
                                           sb,
                                           bl,
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           fast,
                                           partial,
                                           n,
                                           before,
                                           fp)
                                         && Q == tlsf_full_malloc_post(
                                              d,
                                              lim,
                                              top,
                                              xs,
                                              hd,
                                              fl,
                                              sb,
                                              bl,
                                              ps,
                                              sz,
                                              loc,
                                              cached,
                                              live,
                                              fast,
                                              partial,
                                              n,
                                              before,
                                              fp)))

```

  (pop push initialize_idx page_idx take_idx ensure_idx full_idx lim : Num)

       && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(

            [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
            tlsf_pop_code(d))
       && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
            inst,
            Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
            [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
            tlsf_push_code(d))
       && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, ensure_idx), fs) == Func_native(
            inst,
            Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
            [T_num(T_i32)],
            tlsf_ensure_code(d, pop, push)))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, full_idx), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32),
           T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_full_malloc_code(
            d,
            initialize_idx,
            page_idx,
            take_idx,
            ensure_idx))
  2. keep(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       lift(
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           ∃ args : List[Value],
             vs == APPEND(NIL, args)
             && lc == caller

  3. reduce_trans(

definition `tlsf_public_free_state`

```
∀ (d : W32) (lim : Num) (fp : GProp),
  tlsf_public_free_state(d, lim, fp) == (
    (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ms == lim
      && (
           ∃ top : W32,
             ∃ xs : List[W32],
               ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
                 ∃ fl : W32,
                   ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                     ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                       ∃ ps : List[W32],
                         ∃ sz : (W32) -> Num,
                           ∃ loc : (W32) -> List[W32],
                             ∃ cached : (W32) -> List[W32],
                               ∃ live : (W32) -> List[W32],
                                 ∃ fast : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                   ∃ partial : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                     (
                                       (
                                         tlsf_allocator(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top,
                                           xs,
                                           hd,
                                           fl,
                                           sb,
                                           bl,
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           fast,
                                           partial)
                                         * fp(gs, ms))(h))))
```

definition `tlsf_public_free_pre`

```
∀ (d top fl ptr : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp),
  tlsf_public_free_pre(
    d,
    lim,
    top,
    xs,
    hd,
    fl,
    sb,
    bl,
    ps,
    sz,
    loc,
    cached,
    live,
    fast,
    partial,
    ptr,
    fp) == (
    (args : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      args == [V_num(ConstInt32(ptr))]
      && ms == lim
      && (
           ptr == 0w
           && (
                (
                  tlsf_allocator(
                    d,
                    lim,
                    top,
                    xs,
                    hd,
                    fl,
                    sb,
                    bl,
                    ps,
                    sz,
                    loc,
                    cached,
                    live,
                    fast,
                    partial)
                  * fp(gs, ms))(h))
           || (
                ∃ cap : Num,
                  tlsf_malloc_owned(
                    d,
                    lim,
                    top,
                    xs,
                    hd,
                    fl,
                    sb,
                    bl,
                    ps,
                    sz,
                    loc,
                    cached,
                    live,
                    fast,
                    partial,
                    ptr,
                    cap)
                  && (
                       (
                         tlsf_allocator(
                           d,
                           lim,
                           top,
                           xs,
                           hd,
                           fl,
                           sb,
                           bl,
                           ps,
                           sz,
                           loc,
                           cached,
                           live,
                           fast,
                           partial)
                         * tlsf_bytes(val(ptr), cap)
                         * fp(gs, ms)
                         * emp)(h)))))
```

definition `tlsf_public_free_post`

```
∀ (d : W32) (lim : Num) (fp : GProp),
  tlsf_public_free_post(d, lim, fp) == (
    (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      res == NIL && tlsf_public_free_state(d, lim, fp, gs, ms, h))
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_unpayload`

```
∀ (m : W32), ((m +₃₂ 8w) −₃₂ 8w) == m
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_tag_mask`

```
∀ (h : W32),
  (tlsf_size(h) &₃₂ 4w) == (h &₃₂ 4w)
  && (tlsf_size(h) &₃₂ 7w &₃₂ 4w) == (tlsf_size(h) &₃₂ 4w)
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_large_tag`

```
∀ (h : W32)
if
  1. MOD(val(tlsf_size(h)), 8) == 0
then
  (h &₃₂ 4w) == 0w
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_guard_value`

```
∀ (d : W32)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
then
  val((tlsf_base(d) +₃₂ 2184w)) == val(tlsf_base(d)) + 2184
  && 0 < val((tlsf_base(d) +₃₂ 2184w))
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_block_geometry`

```
∀ (d top fl m : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)
  && lim <= 4294967296
  && tlsf_origin(d) <= val(m)
  && val(d) <= 4294965088
  && (hd(m) &₃₂ 4w) == 0w
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_pointer_guard`

```
∀ (d m : W32)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. tlsf_origin(d) <= val(m)
  3. val(m) + 8 < 4294967296
then
  val((m +₃₂ 8w)) == val(m) + 8
  && !word_ult((m +₃₂ 8w), (tlsf_base(d) +₃₂ 2184w))
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_read_large`

```
∀ (d top fl m : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (client : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. MEM(m, xs)
  2. (
       tlsf_allocator(
         d,
         lim,
         top,
         xs,
         hd,
         fl,
         sb,
         bl,
         ps,
         sz,
         loc,
         cached,
         live,
         fast,
         partial)
       * client)(h)
then
  has_i32(h, val(m), hd(m))
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_slot_view`

```
∀ (p b : W32) (cap s i : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  2. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  3. MEM(b, live)
then
  ∃ (rest : HProp),
    tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
      == (pts(val(b), serialise_i32(4w)) * rest)
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_small_geometry`

```
∀ (d top fl p b : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  4. MEM(p, ps)
  5. MEM(b, live(p))
then
  val((b +₃₂ 8w)) == val(b) + 8
  && !word_ult((b +₃₂ 8w), (tlsf_base(d) +₃₂ 2184w))
```

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)

lemma `tlsf_public_free_large_call`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (pop push free_idx lim : Num)
  (d top fl m : W32) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp) (caller : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
  3. !MEM(m, ps)
  4. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  6. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  7. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m))],
      caller,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && (
             (
               tlsf_allocator(
                 d,
                 lim,
                 top,
                 xs,
                 hd,
                 fl,
                 sb,
                 bl,
                 ps,
                 sz,
                 loc,
                 cached,
                 live,
                 fast,
                 partial)
               * tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m))))
               * fp(gs, ms)
               * emp)(h))),
    [Call(free_idx)],
    st([V_num(ConstInt32(0w))], caller, tlsf_public_free_state(d, lim, fp)),
    NIL)
```

lemma `tlsf_public_free_entry_cases`

```
∀ (d top fl ptr : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp) (vs lc gs : List[Value]) (h : Heap)
if
  1. (
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         vs == NIL
         && lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(ptr)), l1, l2]
         && tlsf_public_free_pre(
              d,
              lim,
              top,
              xs,
              hd,
              fl,
              sb,
              bl,
              ps,
              sz,
              loc,
              cached,
              live,
              fast,
              partial,
              ptr,
              fp,
              [V_num(ConstInt32(ptr))],
              gs,
              ms,
              h))(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
then
  (
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      (
        tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
        && tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
        && tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
        && ptr == 0w)
      && st(
           NIL,
           [V_num(ConstInt32(ptr)), l1, l2],
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
             ms == lim
             && (
                  (
                    tlsf_allocator(
                      d,
                      lim,
                      top,
                      xs,
                      hd,
                      fl,
                      sb,
                      bl,
                      ps,
                      sz,
                      loc,
                      cached,
                      live,
                      fast,
                      partial)
                    * fp(gs, lim))(h)),
           vs,
           lc,
           gs,
           ms,
           h)
      || (
           ∃ b : W32,
             (
               tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
               && tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
               && tlsf_small_lists_ok(
                    ps,
                    sz,
                    loc,
                    cached,
                    live,
                    fast,
                    partial)
               && MEM(b, xs)
               && !MEM(b, ps)
               && tlsf_used(hd(b))
               && ptr == (b +₃₂ 8w))
             && st(
                  NIL,
                  [V_num(ConstInt32(ptr)), l1, l2],
                  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
                    ms == lim
                    && (
                         (
                           tlsf_allocator(
                             d,
                             lim,
                             top,
                             xs,
                             hd,
                             fl,
                             sb,
                             bl,
                             ps,
                             sz,
                             loc,
                             cached,
                             live,
                             fast,
                             partial)
                           * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(b))))
                           * fp(gs, ms)
                           * emp)(h)),
                  vs,
                  lc,
                  gs,
                  ms,
                  h))
      || (
           ∃ p : W32,
             ∃ b : W32,
               (
                 tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
                 && tlsf_small_backing(
                      xs,
                      hd,
                      ps,
                      sz,

                      cached,
                      live,
                      lim)
                 && tlsf_small_lists_ok(
                      ps,
                      sz,
                      loc,
                      cached,
                      live,
                      fast,
                      partial)
                 && MEM(p, ps)
                 && MEM(b, live(p))
                 && ptr == (b +₃₂ 8w))
               && st(
                    NIL,
                    [V_num(ConstInt32(ptr)), l1, l2],
                    (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
                      ms == lim
                      && (
                           (

                               d,
                               lim,
                               top,
                               xs,
                               hd,
                               fl,
                               sb,
                               bl,
                               ps,
                               sz,
                               loc,
                               cached,
                               live,
                               fast,
                               partial)
                             * tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 8, sz(p))

                             * emp)(h)),
                    vs,

                    ms,

lemma `tlsf_public_free_native_body`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)
  (pop push free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl ptr : W32) (xs ps : List[W32])

  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp) (args : List[Value])

  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],

  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],

then

    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>

      tlsf_public_free_post(d, lim, fp, vs, gs, ms, h),
    [
      (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
      (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>

definition `tlsf_public_free_spec`

∀ (inst : Inst) (d : W32) (free_idx public_idx j : Num) (P Q : FProp),
  tlsf_public_free_spec(inst, d, free_idx, public_idx, j, P, Q) == (
    j == sfunc_ind(inst, public_idx)
    && (
         ∃ lim : Num,
           ∃ top : W32,
             ∃ xs : List[W32],
               ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
                 ∃ fl : W32,
                   ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                     ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                       ∃ ps : List[W32],
                         ∃ sz : (W32) -> Num,
                           ∃ loc : (W32) -> List[W32],
                             ∃ cached : (W32) -> List[W32],
                               ∃ live : (W32) -> List[W32],
                                 ∃ fast : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                   ∃ partial : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                     ∃ ptr : W32,
                                       ∃ fp : GProp,
                                         P == tlsf_public_free_pre(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top,
                                           xs,
                                           hd,
                                           fl,
                                           sb,
                                           bl,
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           fast,
                                           partial,
                                           ptr,
                                           fp)
                                         && Q == tlsf_public_free_post(
                                              d,
                                              lim,
                                              fp)))

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],

  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)

lemma `tlsf_public_free_run`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)
  (pop push free_idx public_idx lim : Num) (d top fl ptr : W32)
  (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp) (vs0 lc0 vs : List[Value]) (fr : HProp) (s s2 : Wstore)
  (f f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, public_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_public_free_code(d, free_idx))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_pop_code(d))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. s_funcs(s) == fs
  3. s_tabs(s) == tabs
  4. f_inst(f) == inst
  5. lift(
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         ∃ args : List[Value],
           vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
           && lc == lc0
           && tlsf_public_free_pre(
                d,
                lim,
                top,
                xs,
                hd,
                fl,
                sb,
                bl,
                ps,
                sz,
                loc,
                cached,
                live,
                fast,
                partial,
                ptr,
                fp,
                args,
                gs,
                ms,
                h),
       fr,
       s,
       f,
       vs)
  6. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, [Call(public_idx)]))),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (vs2 : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs2)
    && s_funcs(s2) == fs
    && s_tabs(s2) == tabs
    && f_inst(f2) == inst
    && lift(
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           ∃ res : List[Value],
             vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
             && lc == lc0
             && tlsf_public_free_post(d, lim, fp, res, gs, ms, h),
         fr,
         s2,
         f2,
         vs2)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)
```

## Lazy initialization of allocation entry points (tlsf_malloc_start_*.mbt)

definition `tlsf_safer_abort`

```
tlsf_safer_abort(
  0,
  (s : Wstore),
  (f : Wframe),
  (es : List[Einstr]),
  (q : Assn),
  (l : List[Assn]),
  (rq : Assn),
  (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool))
  == true
&& tlsf_safer_abort(
     SUC((n : Num)),
     (s : Wstore),
     (f : Wframe),
     (es : List[Einstr]),
     (q : Assn),
     (l : List[Assn]),
     (rq : Assn),
     (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)) == (
     (∃ vs : List[Value], es == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && q(s, f, vs))
     || (
          ∃ i : Num,
            ∃ vs : List[Value],
              ∃ lh : Lholed,
                i < LENGTH(l)
                && es == lfill(
                     lh,
                     APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i + lh_depth(lh)))]))
                && EL(i, l, s, f, vs)
                && (
                     ∀ s2 : Wstore,
                       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                         ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                           reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → tlsf_safer_abort(
                             n,
                             s2,
                             f2,
                             es2,
                             q,
                             l,
                             rq,
                             ab)))
     || (
          ∃ vs : List[Value],
            ∃ lh : Lholed,
              es == lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]))
              && rq(s, f, vs))
     || es == [Trap] && ab(s, f)
     || (
          ∃ s2 : Wstore,
            ∃ f2 : Wframe, ∃ es2 : List[Einstr], reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2))
        && (
             ∀ s2 : Wstore,
               ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                 ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                   reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → tlsf_safer_abort(
                     n,
                     s2,
                     f2,
                     es2,
                     q,
                     l,
                     rq,
                     ab)))
```

lemma `tlsf_safer_abort_seq`

```
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es1 es2 : List[Einstr]) (q r rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn]) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, es1, q, l, rq, ab)
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ m : Num,
             m <= n → q(s, f, vs) → tlsf_safer_abort(
               m,
               s,
               f,
               APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), es2),
               r,
               l,
               rq,
               ab)
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, APPEND(es1, es2), r, l, rq, ab)
```

lemma `tlsf_safer_abort_mono`

```
∀ (n : Num) (ab ab2 : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe)
  (es : List[Einstr]) (q q2 rq rq2 : Assn) (l l2 : List[Assn])
if
  1. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], q(s, f, vs) → q2(s, f, vs)
  2. LENGTH(l2) == LENGTH(l)
  3. ∀ i : Num,
       ∀ s : Wstore,
         ∀ f : Wframe,
           ∀ vs : List[Value],
             i < LENGTH(l) && EL(i, l, s, f, vs) → EL(i, l2, s, f, vs)
  4. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rq(s, f, vs) → rq2(s, f, vs)
  5. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ab(s, f) → ab2(s, f)
  6. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, es, q, l, rq, ab)
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, es, q2, l2, rq2, ab2)
```

lemma `tlsf_safer_abort_label`

```
∀ (n m : Num) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe)
  (vs0 : List[Value]) (e0 li : List[Einstr]) (qb lb q rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, li, qb, CONS(lb, l), rq, ab)
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s, f, vs) → q(s, f, APPEND(vs0, vs))
  3. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ k : Num,
             k <= n → lb(s, f, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
             && tlsf_safer_abort(
                  k,
                  s,
                  f,
                  APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), e0)),
                  q,
                  l,
                  rq,
                  ab)
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(
    n,
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li)]),
    q,
    l,
    rq,
    ab)
```

lemma `tlsf_safer_abort_label_top`

```
∀ (n m : Num) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe)
  (li : List[Einstr]) (qb rb : Assn)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, li, qb, [qb], rb, ab)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, [Label(m, NIL, li)], qb, NIL, rb, ab)
```

lemma `tlsf_frame_abort_can_step`

```
∀ (n m : Num) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s : Wstore) (f0 f1 : Wframe)
  (vs0 : List[Value]) (es : List[Einstr]) (qin rin : Assn)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(SUC(n), s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin, ab)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rin(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  ∃ (s2 : Wstore) (f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)
```

lemma `tlsf_frame_abort_next`

```
∀ (n m : Num) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool) (s s2 : Wstore)
  (f0 f1 f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (es es2 : List[Einstr])
  (qin rin : Assn)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(SUC(n), s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin, ab)
  2. reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rin(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  ∃ (f1' : Wframe) (es' : List[Einstr]),
    tlsf_safer_abort(n, s2, f1', es', qin, NIL, rin, ab)
    && f2 == f0
    && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1', es')])
or
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f0
  && ∃ vs : List[Value],
       es2 == MAP(v_to_e, APPEND(vs0, vs)) && (qin(s, f1, vs) || rin(s, f1, vs))
or
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f0
  && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Trap])
  && ab(s, f1)
```

lemma `tlsf_frame_abort_safe`

```
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f0 f1 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es : List[Einstr]) (qin rin q : Assn) (ain ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin, ain)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs2 : List[Value], qin(s2, f2, vs2) → q(s2, f0, APPEND(vs0, vs2))
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs2 : List[Value],
           rin(s2, f2, vs2) → LENGTH(vs2) == m && q(s2, f0, APPEND(vs0, vs2))
  4. ∀ s2 : Wstore, ∀ f2 : Wframe, ain(s2, f2) → ab(s2, f0)
then
  safe_abort(n, s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), q, ab)
```

definition `tlsf_sl_abort_r`

```
tlsf_sl_abort_r(
  (fs : List[Cl]),
  (tabs : Tabs),
  (inst : Inst),
  (rp : SAssn),
  (P : SAssn),
  (bs : List[B_e]),
  (Q : SAssn),
  (ls : List[SAssn]),
  (A : SAssn)) == (
  ∀ n : Num,
    ∀ fr : HProp,
      ∀ s : Wstore,
        ∀ f : Wframe,
          ∀ vs : List[Value],
            keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(P, fr), s, f, vs) → tlsf_safer_abort(
              n,
              s,
              f,
              APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, bs)),
              keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(Q, fr)),
              MAP(keep(fs, tabs, inst), MAP((x : SAssn) => lift(x, fr), ls)),
              keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(rp, fr)),
              (s : Wstore) => (f : Wframe) =>
                keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(A, fr), s, f, NIL)))
```

lemma `tlsf_safer_abort_to_abort`

```
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q rq : Assn)
  (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)
if
  1. ∀ s2 : Wstore, ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], !rq(s2, f2, vs)
  2. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, es, q, NIL, rq, ab)
then
  safe_abort(n, s, f, es, q, ab)
```

then
  tlsf_sl_abort_r(

lemma `tlsf_sl_abort_r_conseq`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp P P2 Q Q2 A A2 : SAssn)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, P2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → P(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. tlsf_sl_abort_r(fs, tabs, inst, rp, P, bs, Q, ls, A)
  3. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, Q(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → Q2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  4. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, A(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → A2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
then
  tlsf_sl_abort_r(fs, tabs, inst, rp, P2, bs, Q2, ls, A2)
```

lemma `tlsf_sl_abort_r_weaken`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)
  (rp rp2 P P2 Q Q2 L L2 A A2 : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, P2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → P(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. tlsf_sl_abort_r(fs, tabs, inst, rp, P, bs, Q, [L], A)
  3. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, Q(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → Q2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  4. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num,
             ∀ h : Heap, rp(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → rp2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  5. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, L(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → L2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  6. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, A(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → A2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
then
  tlsf_sl_abort_r(fs, tabs, inst, rp2, P2, bs, Q2, [L2], A2)
```

∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (P : SAssn) (fr : HProp)

if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, P(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(vs) == m
  2. keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(P, fr), s, f, vs)
then
  LENGTH(vs) == m
```

lemma `tlsf_start_native_call`

```
∀ (n j : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (arg : Value) (i : Inst)
  (ts : List[Valtype]) (code : List[B_e]) (zs : List[Value]) (qin q : Assn)
  (ain a : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(f_inst(f), j), s_funcs(s))
       == Func_native(i, Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]), ts, code)
     && n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
  2. ∀ k : Num,
       tlsf_safer_abort(
         k,
         s,
         Wframe(CONS(arg, zs), i),
         MAP(Basic, code),
         qin,
         [qin],
         qin,
         ain)
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qin(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == 1
  4. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qin(s2, f2, vs) → q(s2, f, vs)
  5. ∀ s2 : Wstore, ∀ f2 : Wframe, ain(s2, f2) → a(s2, f)
then
  safe_abort(n, s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, [arg]), [Basic(Call(j))]), q, a)
```

lemma `tlsf_sl_abort_call_value_r`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (arg : Value) (j : Num)
  (ts : List[Valtype]) (code : List[B_e]) (zs lc0 : List[Value]) (P A : GProp)
  (Q : FProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, j), fs)
       == Func_native(inst, Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]), ts, code)
  2. n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
  3. ∀ res : List[Value],
       ∀ gs : List[Value],
         ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, Q(res, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(res) == 1
  4. tlsf_sl_abort_r(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         Q(vs, gs, ms, h),
       st(NIL, CONS(arg, zs), P),
       code,
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         Q(vs, gs, ms, h),
       [
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           Q(vs, gs, ms, h)],
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         A(gs, ms, h))
then
  sl_abort_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st([arg], lc0, P),
    [Call(j)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc == lc0 && Q(vs, gs, ms, h),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      A(gs, ms, h))
```

lemma `tlsf_start_block_step`

```
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (ot : Option[Valtype]) (bs : List[B_e])
  (qb lb q rq : Assn) (ls : List[Assn]) (ab : (Wstore, Wframe) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_safer_abort(n, s, f, MAP(Basic, bs), qb, CONS(lb, ls), rq, ab)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s2, f2, vs) → q(s2, f2, vs)
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           lb(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == LENGTH(tbv_results(ot))
           && q(s2, f2, vs)
then
  tlsf_safer_abort(SUC(n), s, f, [Basic(Block(Tbv(ot), bs))], q, ls, rq, ab)
```

lemma `tlsf_sl_abort_r_block`

```
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp Q A : SAssn)
  (ot : Option[Valtype]) (lc : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (bs : List[B_e])
  (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. tlsf_sl_abort_r(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       st(NIL, lc, R),
       bs,
       Q,
       CONS(
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           LENGTH(vs) == LENGTH(tbv_results(ot)) && Q(vs, lc, gs, ms, h),
         ls),
       A)
then
  tlsf_sl_abort_r(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(NIL, lc, R),
    [Block(Tbv(ot), bs)],
    Q,
    ls,
    A)
```

lemma `tlsf_malloc_try_resume_fresh_case`

```
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn])
  (initialize_idx page_idx take_idx ensure_idx pop push lim i : Num)
  (original l0 l1 l2 l3 l4 : Value) (d top fl n p b : W32)
  (xs ps bs z : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  4. !word_ugt(d, 4294965088w)
     && !word_uge(
          ((d +₃₂ 15w &₃₂ 4294967280w) +₃₂ 1908w >>>₃₂ 16w),
          word(DIV(lim, 65536)))
     && !(top == 0w)
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
     && EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
          inst,
          Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
          [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32),
           T_num(T_i32)],
          tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
